articles.title: ComplexIF: A Challenging Multi-Turn, Multi-Constraint Instruction-Following Benchmark
articles.abstract: As frontier LLMs saturate existing instruction-following benchmarks, measuring further progress requires harder tests that remain faithful to real use. In practice, users often combine several constraints, add them at different turns of a conversation, and expect all of them to hold in the assistant's response. We introduce ComplexIF, a challenging benchmark for this setting, together with the automatic pipeline that generates it. The pipeline expands seed requests into multi-turn conversations, weaves constraints into their turns, and keeps only tasks that a strong model can solve, so difficulty can be raised by adding constraints or turns while every task stays solvable. ComplexIF's two splits test complementary sides of instruction following: a verifiable split of format constraints, checked by programs, and a rubric split of semantic instructions, such as a tone or an audience, checked with an LLM judge. Across 14 proprietary and open-weight models, even the strongest satisfies every constraint on fewer than half of the verifiable tasks, and no model leads on both splits.
articles.titleCn: 复杂IF：一个具有挑战性的多轮、多约束指令遵循基准
articles.abstractCn: 随着前沿的大型语言模型在现有指令遵循基准测试中达到饱和，衡量进一步进展需要更严格的测试，这些测试应忠实于实际应用。在实践中，用户通常结合多个约束条件，在不同的对话回合中添加它们，并期望所有约束条件都包含在助手的回应中。我们引入了ComplexIF，这是一个针对此场景的具有挑战性的基准测试，以及生成它的自动流程。该流程将种子请求扩展为多回合对话，将约束条件编织到它们的回合中，并仅保留强模型能够解决的问题，因此可以通过添加约束条件或回合来提高难度，同时每个任务都保持可解。ComplexIF的两个划分测试指令遵循的两个互补方面：一个由程序检查的格式约束的可验证划分，以及一个由大型语言模型裁判检查的语义指令的评分划分，例如语气或受众。在14个专有和开放权重模型中，即使是 strongest 模型在可验证任务中也不满足不到一半的约束条件，并且没有模型在两个划分中都领先。

articles.title: Sánchez, Feijóo, or Abascal? Speaker Attribution and Ideological Congruence in LLM Personas Reading Posts on X of the Leaders of the Three Main Parties of the 29N General Election in Spain
articles.abstract: Source cues are central to political communication, yet reception studies with large language model (LLM) personas as synthetic audiences have not tested whether personas respond to who speaks and not only to what is said. With Spain's general election of 29 November 2026 in mind, we run a speaker-attribution experiment using 1,075 anonymised X posts by the leaders of PSOE, PP and VOX on four topics (the economy and employment, household costs, immigration and corruption) and 791 distinct value-grounded, LLM-generated personas. Each post was assigned to 300 topic-selected persona profiles, 150 grounded in the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map and 150 in Moral Foundations Theory, under four conditions: no author, Sánchez, Feijóo or Abascal, yielding 322,470 complete persona-post quartets. Naming any leader lowered support for identical text, with the penalty for Abascal nearly twice as large as those for Sánchez and Feijóo. The penalty follows the persona's elicited left-right self-placement (ideological congruence): left personas spare Sánchez and right personas spare Feijóo, although ideology was never in the message-evaluation prompt. Corruption posts were penalised under every name, whereas on other topics the ideologically closest leader generally produced little or no penalty. The leader order matches public opinion in 48 CIS barometers (2022-2026) in all three groups and the sign of all twelve differences, but fits barometers before the model's 2024 knowledge cutoff better than recent ones. Our findings demonstrate that LLM personas evaluate political speakers through systematic, value-congruent priors: however, while they replicate human candidate rank-orders across survey barometers, this alignment is ordinal rather than quantitative, highlighting their utility for controlled source-effect experiments though not as substitutes for empirical public opinion surveys.
articles.comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 31 tables. Code and configuration: https://github.com/VictorMYeste/spanish-political-communication
articles.titleCn: 桑切斯、费尔南多·佩约或阿巴卡萨尔？在西班牙29N大选主要三个政党的领导人阅读推特帖子时，大型语言模型角色扮演中的说话人归属和意识形态一致性
articles.abstractCn: 来源线索是政治传播的核心，然而，以大型语言模型（LLM）角色作为合成受众的接收研究尚未检验角色是否仅对所说的内容做出反应，而不仅对说话者是谁做出反应。考虑到2026年11月29日的西班牙大选，我们进行了一项说话者归因实验，使用PSOE、PP和VOX领导人关于四个主题（经济与就业、家庭成本、移民与腐败）的1,075条匿名X帖子，以及791个独特的基于价值观的、由LLM生成的角色。每条帖子被分配给300个主题选择的角色档案，其中150个基于英格尔哈特-韦尔策文化地图，另外150个基于道德基础理论，在四种条件下：无作者、桑切斯、费尔南多或阿巴卡尔，产生了322,470个完整的角色-帖子四元组。提及任何领导人都会降低相同文本的支持率，阿巴卡尔的惩罚几乎是桑切斯和费尔南多的两倍。这种惩罚遵循角色诱发的左右自我定位（意识形态一致性）：左倾角色会保留桑切斯，右倾角色会保留费尔南多，尽管意识形态从未出现在消息评估提示中。腐败帖子在所有名字下都受到惩罚，而在其他主题上，意识形态上最接近的领导人通常不会产生惩罚或很少产生惩罚。领导人的顺序在所有三个群体中的48个CIS晴雨表中（2022-2026年）与公众舆论一致，包括所有十二个差异的符号，但比模型2024年知识截止日期之前的晴雨表更符合最近的晴雨表。我们的研究结果表明，LLM角色通过系统性的、与价值观一致的先验知识来评估政治发言人：然而，尽管它们在调查晴雨表中复制了人类的候选人排名顺序，但这种一致性是序数而非定量的，突出了它们在受控来源效应实验中的实用性，但并非作为实证公众舆论调查的替代品。

articles.title: Refine, Don't Reinvent: RASA-Bench for Source-Grounded Hindi Prose Refinement
articles.abstract: For a producer of Hindi creative prose, drafting is cheap and editing is not: a machine-written episode, story, or essay reads as under-written and flat, laced with translationese, and it sometimes quietly alters what the source says. RASA-Bench targets that editing task across three Hindi prose forms, measuring how well a model refines an under-written AI draft, a task distinct from writing from scratch. Across 2,050 drafts and eight refiners (16,400 rewrites), a four-layer protocol credits a rewrite only after it passes a faithfulness check against its own source, then ranks the survivors by holistic editorial preference through per-form Bradley-Terry fits whose centered coefficients are standardized before equal-weight averaging. Staying faithful proves to be a decisive test that behaves differently by form: gate-failure rates range from 9.1% on short stories to 29.5% on audio fiction, and the drift that disqualifies a rewrite shifts from events and identity in narrative to claims and evidence in essays. A 600-case human audit puts gate agreement at 0.925 (0.91 to 0.94 across forms), whereas subjective preference is form-sensitive and least settled for essays, among human readers no less than the model judge. The benchmark, evaluation protocol, and Hindi prose diagnostics are available at https://abdur75648.github.io/rasa-bench.
articles.comment: Accepted to EACL 2027. 22 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://abdur75648.github.io/rasa-bench
articles.titleCn: 精炼，而非重塑：用于源语引导的印地语散文精炼的RASA-Bench
articles.abstractCn: 对于创作印地语散文的创作者而言，草稿成本低而编辑成本高：机器生成的章节、故事或文章读起来显得草率平淡，充斥着翻译腔，有时还会悄无声息地改变原文内容。RASA-Bench针对三种印地语散文形式中的编辑任务，衡量模型如何改进草率的AI草稿，这项任务与从零开始写作不同。在2050份草稿和八位编辑（16400次改写）中，四层协议要求改写必须通过与其自身来源的忠实度检查后才能被认可，然后通过每项的Bradley-Terry拟合来对幸存者进行整体编辑偏好排名，其中心化系数在等权重平均前进行标准化。忠实度证明是一项决定性的测试，其表现因形式而异：门禁失败率从短篇小说的9.1%到音频小说的29.5%不等，而使改写被淘汰的偏差从叙事中的事件和身份转向了议论文中的主张和证据。600个案例的人工审核将门禁一致性定为0.925（跨形式为0.91至0.94），而主观偏好对形式敏感，议论文在人类读者中甚至比模型裁判更难确定。基准测试、评估协议和印地语散文诊断工具可在https://abdur75648.github.io/rasa-bench获取。

articles.title: ReqSeek: Transformer-Based Automatic Requirements Identification for Building Large Requirements Datasets
articles.abstract: Large, diverse, and high-quality datasets are significant for advancing AI in requirements engineering, yet automated identification of requirements from Software Requirement Specifications (SRS) remains a challenge. Automatic Requirements Identification (ARI) methods demonstrate limited generalization to unseen documents across heterogeneous SRSs. This work presents ReqSeek, a transformer-based, domain-agnostic ARI model for recognizing ISO 29148-style requirements in SRS documents, supporting dataset construction. We curated the Automatic Requirements Identification Dataset (ARID), comprising 2,396 training instances from 23 heterogeneous SRSs, and fine-tuned four transformer architectures. RoBERTa was selected as the base model for ReqSeek and achieved 95% precision, recall, F1, and F0.89 on the held-out evaluation set. Exploratory human-model benchmarking showed performance comparable to humans while requiring substantially less prediction time than manual annotation. Post-hoc evaluation on out-of-domain (OoD) SRSs provided evidence of requirement identification beyond ARID. Robustness analysis demonstrated ReqSeek's insensitivity to minor linguistic variations while maintaining sensitivity to major ISO 29148-style violations. We applied ReqSeek to construct the Software Requirements Dataset (SwaRD), identifying 10,201 ISO 29148-style requirements from 231 industrial SRSs. SwaRD aligns with textual and semantic properties of human-curated datasets while exceeding them in scale and domain diversity. Our results suggest that transformer-based ARI can provide precise and generalizable requirements identification.
articles.comment: Accepted for publication in ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM), 2026
articles.titleCn: ReqSeek：基于Transformer的自动需求识别，用于构建大型需求数据集
articles.abstractCn: 大规模、多样化且高质量的数据集对于推动需求工程中的人工智能发展至关重要，然而从软件需求规格说明（SRS）中自动识别需求仍然是一个挑战。自动需求识别（ARI）方法在异构SRS文档中对未见过的文档泛化能力有限。本研究提出了ReqSeek，一种基于Transformer、领域无关的ARI模型，用于识别SRS文档中的ISO 29148风格需求，并支持数据集构建。我们精心策划了自动需求识别数据集（ARID），其中包含来自23种异构SRS的2,396个训练实例，并对四种Transformer架构进行了微调。RoBERTa被选为ReqSeek的基础模型，在保留的评估集上达到了95%的精确率、召回率、F1值和F0.89。探索性的人机模型基准测试显示，其性能与人类相当，但预测时间远少于人工标注。在域外（OoD）SRS上的事后评估提供了超出ARID的需求识别证据。鲁棒性分析表明，ReqSeek对细微语言变化不敏感，同时保持对重大ISO 29148风格违规的敏感性。我们将ReqSeek应用于构建软件需求数据集（SwaRD），从231个工业SRS中识别出10,201个ISO 29148风格需求。SwaRD在文本和语义属性上与人工策划的数据集保持一致，但在规模和领域多样性上超越了它们。我们的结果表明，基于Transformer的ARI可以提供精确且泛化的需求识别能力。

articles.title: Loop-Count Schedules in Looped Transformers: An Empirical Study
articles.abstract: Looped transformers apply one block of layers several times with shared weights, trading parameters for repeated computation. We study how the schedule of the loop iteration count R during training determines whether each extra pass acts as a full layer or as a small correction, using a controlled ladder of 46M-110M-parameter models trained on 2B tokens with learned residual gates on every loop pass and three schedules: R fixed to 2, R sampled uniformly from {1,...,6}, and R sampled from {2,3,4}. We find that the lower bound of the sampling range is the decisive choice. If the sampled range includes R=1, so that some training steps run the block only once and compute the loss on that single pass, the gates collapse to 0.1-0.5 and each additional pass becomes a small correction to the first; if the range starts at R=2, so that every training step runs the block at least twice, the gates stay at 0.6-0.9 and each pass keeps the strength of a full layer, while the model can still be run at any R from 2 up to twice the largest trained value with validation loss within a few hundredths of a nat of its best. The {2, 3, 4} schedule gives the best looped model, 2.909 nats against 2.951 for the parameter-matched plain model, and degrades by only 0.038 nats when run at twice its trained depth. We further show that under a fixed R the direction of the residual stream converges geometrically beyond the trained depth while the loss diverges, which refines a recent finding that static-depth training does not converge, and that reusing the first pass's keys and values on later passes costs 0.01-0.03 nats in every regime while making the per-token iteration uniformly contractive and halving the inference cache. The loop recovers about a third of what real depth provides at equal parameters. The code, trained weights, and per-token traces are released.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/kvoyager/gatedloop-transformer. Trained weights and per-token traces: https://huggingface.co/konstank/gatedloop-transformer
articles.titleCn: 循环变换器中的循环计数调度：一项实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 循环Transformer通过共享权重多次应用一个层块，用重复计算来交换参数。我们研究了在训练过程中循环迭代次数R的调度如何决定每个额外遍历是作为一个完整层还是作为一个小修正，使用一个受控的阶梯式46M-110M参数模型，在2B个token上进行训练，每个循环遍历都有学习的残差门，以及三种调度方案：R固定为2，R从{1,...,6}中均匀采样，以及R从{2,3,4}中采样。我们发现采样范围的下限是决定性选择。如果采样范围包括R=1，使得某些训练步骤只运行一次块并计算该单次遍历的损失，门会收缩到0.1-0.5，每个额外遍历都成为对第一个的小修正；如果范围从R=2开始，使得每个训练步骤至少运行两次块，门会保持在0.6-0.9，每个遍历保持完整层的强度，同时模型仍可在2到训练最大值的两倍范围内运行，验证损失在其最佳值的百分之几百内。{2, 3, 4}调度给出了最佳的循环模型，2.909 nat，对比参数匹配的普通模型为2.951 nat，在其训练深度的两倍下运行时仅下降0.038 nat。我们进一步表明，在固定R下，残差流的方向在训练深度后几何收敛，而损失发散，这完善了最近的一项发现，即静态深度训练不收敛，并且重用第一次遍历的键和值在后续遍历中每轮成本为0.01-0.03 nat，同时使每token迭代均匀收缩并减半推理缓存。循环大约恢复了实际深度在相同参数下提供的三分之一。代码、训练权重和每token跟踪已发布。

articles.title: Where Do Fact-Checking Errors Arise? Separating Retrieval, Search Control and Judgement in Evidence-Grounded Verification
articles.abstract: An evidence-grounded fact-checker can fail because it does not find the evidence or because it does not use it; end-to-end accuracy does not tell the two apart. We present a protocol that follows the reference evidence from the store to the verdict and separates retrieval, search control, judgement and verdict validation. We assess 293 claims from FEVER, FEVER 2.0 and AVeriTeC with one open-weights 9B model under two evidence conditions: small stores of annotated evidence, where discovery is easy, and the full source collections. In the control condition a single hybrid retrieval pass delivers complete reference evidence for 226 of 228 evidence-bearing claims, and adaptive controllers and a tool agent spend two to nine times as many model calls without a consistent gain. Of 34 decisive claims labelled as lacking evidence, 33 have the complete evidence in the packet: in 15 the judge abstains, and in 18 validation rules overturn a decisive verdict. On AVeriTeC these rules lower single-pass accuracy by six points, to 65.0% (balanced accuracy 57.6%). Ten judges from eight model families also show abstentions and validation conversions on fixed packets. Against the full stores hybrid single-pass accuracy falls by 17 to 29 points. Wikipedia evidence recovery declines; AVeriTeC recovery changes from annotated answers to cited pages and is measured separately. No controller recovers the accuracy loss. The agent also shows no resolved gain on 714 further Wikipedia claims. Evidence recovery, judgement and validation should be measured separately before an error is attributed to search.
articles.titleCn: 事实核查错误源于何处？在证据支持验证中区分检索、搜索控制和判断
articles.abstractCn: 基于证据的事实核查器可能因未找到证据或未使用证据而失败；端到端准确率无法区分这两种情况。我们提出了一种协议，该协议遵循参考证据从存储到裁决的路径，并将检索、搜索控制、判断和裁决验证分离。我们在两种证据条件下，使用一个开放权重的9B模型，对FEVER、FEVER 2.0和AVeriTeC中的293个声明进行评估：标注证据的小型存储库，其中发现容易，以及完整源集合。在控制条件下，单个混合检索过程为228个证据包含声明中的226个提供了完整的参考证据，而自适应控制器和工具代理花费了多达九倍的模型调用，但没有带来一致的增益。在34个被标记为缺乏证据的决定性声明中，33个在数据包中包含完整证据：在15个声明中，裁判者弃权，而在18个声明中，验证规则推翻了决定性裁决。在AVeriTeC上，这些规则将单次通过准确率降低了六个点，至65.0%（平衡准确率为57.6%）。来自八个模型系列的十个裁判者在固定数据包上也显示了弃权和验证转换。针对完整存储库，混合单次通过准确率降低了17到29个点。维基百科证据恢复率下降；AVeriTeC恢复率从标注答案变为引用页面，并单独测量。没有控制器能够恢复准确率损失。代理在714个进一步的维基百科声明上也没有显示出解决的增益。在将错误归因于搜索之前，证据恢复、判断和验证应单独测量。

articles.title: Grammar Sparsity Sets How Transformers Learn Random Languages
articles.abstract: We study language acquisition by transformers trained on the Random Language Model: a synthetic hierarchical grammar with random production rules, whose sparsity is controlled by a single parameter and whose conditional entropies are known exactly. On depth-two grammars, we find that sparsity sets both the order and the speed of learning. Dense grammars are learnt one level at a time: a token is predicted from its sibling after $t\propto V$ steps and from the full context only after $t\propto V^{3}$, so the two stages are separated by a plateau that widens with $V$. Sparse grammars are learnt all at once, at $t\propto\sqrt V$, with a smaller exponent than even the first stage of a dense one. The exponents $1$ and $1/2$ already appear at depth one, where we derive them for a linear model trained with Adam.
articles.comment: 13 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling
articles.titleCn: 语法稀疏集：Transformer如何学习随机语言
articles.abstractCn: 我们通过在随机语言模型上训练的Transformer来研究语言习得：该模型是一个具有随机生成规则的合成层次语法，其稀疏性由一个参数控制，其条件熵已知。在深度为二的语法中，我们发现稀疏性同时决定了学习的顺序和速度。稠密语法逐层学习：一个符号在经过$t\propto V$步后才从其兄弟符号处被预测，而只有在经过$t\propto V^{3}$步后才能从完整上下文中被预测，因此这两个阶段之间有一个随着$V$增宽的平台期。稀疏语法一次性学习，在$t\propto\sqrt V$时完成，其指数甚至小于稠密语法的第一阶段。指数$1$和$1/2$在深度为一时已经出现，我们在该深度为Adam训练的线性模型中推导出了它们。

articles.title: Do More Roles or Larger Models Improve LLM Fact-Checking? A Controlled Study on Fixed Evidence
articles.abstract: A fact-checking system can spend more computation on a claim by using a larger model, by asking the same model several times, or by a multi-role Tribunal: two roles propose quoted findings, code checks the quotations, an auditor that does not see the proposed relation judges each one, and code derives the verdict or abstains. We compare these options on identical fixed evidence, without retrieval: 300 AVeriTeC claims, each with its annotated question--answer items mixed with items written for other claims, read by judges of four open-weights models from three families, a vote of five, and six assignments of models to the Tribunal's roles. The 9B judge was right on 186 claims and the 27B judge of the same family on 156; the larger judges declined to decide far more often and were no more accurate when they decided. The vote reached 196 and the 9B judge with its verdict replaced by Tribunal certificates 195, at a similar cost; the Tribunal alone reached 153 to 164, because it abstained on almost half of the claims. A hearing's outcome followed the auditor's model and was nearly indifferent to the proposers'. A larger auditor, or one of another family, made certificates neither more often correct (77% to 81%) nor more independent of the judge. As a replacement, certificates improved every judge by 3 to 10 points and overturned four to five in a hundred of its correct verdicts. With the annotated evidence withheld, judges and Tribunal still decided on 7% to 14% of the claims.
articles.titleCn: 在固定证据的条件下，增加角色或使用更大规模的模型能否提升大型语言模型的事实核查能力？一项受控研究
articles.abstractCn: 一个事实核查系统可以通过使用更大的模型、多次询问同一模型或采用多角色陪审团来增加对一项声明所花费的计算量：两个角色提出引用的发现，代码核查引用内容，一个不看到所提议关系的审计员对每一个进行评判，代码得出裁决或弃权。我们在相同固定的证据上，不进行检索的情况下比较了这些选项：300个AVeriTeC声明，每个声明包含其标注的问答项与其他声明编写的项混合，由来自三个系列的四个开放权重模型的法官阅读，进行五票投票，并将模型分配给陪审团的角色共六次。9B法官在186项声明中正确，同一系列的27B法官在156项中正确；较大的法官更频繁地拒绝裁决，且在裁决时准确率并未提高。投票结果达到196票，9B法官的裁决被陪审团证书取代为195票，成本相似；陪审团单独裁决在153至164票之间，因为它在近一半的声明上弃权。听证结果遵循审计员模型，几乎不受提议者模型的影响。更大的审计员或另一系列的审计员使证书既没有更频繁正确（77%至81%），也没有更独立于法官。作为替代，证书使每位法官的评分提高3至10分，并在其正确裁决中推翻了每百个中的四至五个。在标注证据被隐藏的情况下，法官和陪审团仍然对7%至14%的声明做出了裁决。

articles.title: MERIT: Experience-Guided Memory for Long-Horizon Persona-Specific Persuasive Dialogue
articles.abstract: Effective long-horizon persuasion in recurring goal-oriented settings requires more than factual memory: it must track how a user's trust, negotiation behavior, and strategic receptiveness evolve across interactions. Existing persuasive dialogue systems are largely single-session, static, and unimodal, while cross-session memory systems, though temporally aware, retain only factual content and overlook persuasion-specific dynamics. We propose MERIT (Memory-augmented Experience-Rationale for Iterative Temporal persuasion), which pairs a graph-based memory of four persuasion-specific memory types with a per-persona experience rationale library that records which strategies succeed for each user and why. Together they enable adaptive persuasion through prompt composition alone, with no parameter updates. To support this setting, we introduce PERSIST (PERSona-driven InSurance Interactions over Time), a dataset of 60 curated personas spanning 10+ years of motor insurance renewal interactions, with probabilistic life events that shift negotiation behavior and receptiveness across sessions, verified through strict human-in-the-loop annotation. MERIT surpasses memory and experience-based baselines on every metric across two policy backbones, reaching persuasive-appeal scores of 4.10 and 4.74 (out of 5).
articles.titleCn: MERIT：基于经验指导的长时程个性化说服对话记忆
articles.abstractCn: 在周期性目标导向场景中实现有效的长期说服需要超越事实记忆：它必须追踪用户信任、谈判行为和策略接受度随交互过程的变化。现有的说服性对话系统大多为单会话、静态且单模态，而跨会话记忆系统虽然具备时间感知能力，但仅保留事实内容而忽略了说服特有的动态变化。我们提出了MERIT（迭代时间说服的记忆增强经验推理），它将基于图的四种说服特有记忆类型与针对每个用户的经验推理库相结合，后者记录了哪些策略对每个用户有效及其原因。两者协同通过提示组合实现自适应说服，无需参数更新。为支持该场景，我们引入了PERSIST（PERSona驱动的InSurance交互时间序列），这是一个包含60个经过筛选的角色数据集，覆盖了10多年汽车保险续保交互，具有概率性人生事件，这些事件会随会话变化谈判行为和策略接受度，并通过严格的人机交互标注验证。MERIT在两个政策骨干网络上的所有指标均超越了基于记忆和经验的基线，达到了4.10和4.74（满分5分）的说服吸引力得分。

articles.title: Position-Skipped Distillation of Sparse-Attention Indexers: Train Short, Serve Long
articles.abstract: Top-k sparse attention relies on an indexer, a lightweight per-layer module that ranks cached tokens so attention covers only the k highest-scoring ones. Indexers are usually distilled from dense attention at the full serving length, so every training step pays for long-context dense attention. We show that when an indexer is distilled on short sequences, its failure to generalise to longer contexts is driven mainly by rotary positional encoding (RoPE), not by degraded content matching. We propose position-skipped distillation: the indexer and the frozen teacher see short sequences whose position IDs contain a randomly placed gap, so neither ever processes more than the short training length. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B, an indexer distilled on 8K tokens this way matches a 32K-distilled indexer to within about 0.5 perplexity up to 32K, and on DeepSeek-V2-Lite matches a 64K-distilled indexer at 64K with roughly 6x less training compute per token. On Llama-3.1-8B it trails the stronger 32K run by 0.6 perplexity, and at 64K simple position compression is often as good, so the main gain is training cost rather than quality. We also quantise indexer keys to 3-4 bits without retraining and score them with a fused integer kernel: at 4 bits, perplexity changes by at most 0.05 and the scan is 1.6-2.2x faster than half precision. In a current serving engine, the indexer speeds up decoding only for long contexts with multiple concurrent streams.

articles.titleCn: 稀疏注意力索引器的位置跳跃蒸馏：训练简短，服务长久
articles.abstractCn: Top-k稀疏注意力依赖于索引器，这是一种轻量级逐层模块，用于对缓存的token进行排序，使得注意力仅覆盖得分最高的k个token。索引器通常是从全服务长度下的密集注意力中提炼出来的，因此每一步训练都需要为长上下文密集注意力付费。我们证明，当索引器在短序列上提炼时，其无法泛化到更长上下文的原因主要在于旋转位置编码（RoPE），而非内容匹配的退化。我们提出了位置跳跃提炼方法：索引器和冻结的教师模型看到的短序列中，其位置ID包含随机放置的间隙，因此两者处理的长度永远不会超过短训练长度。在DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen3-30B-A3B上，通过这种方法提炼出的8K token索引器，在32K时与32K提炼的索引器在困惑度上相差约0.5，在DeepSeek-V2-Lite上，64K时与64K提炼的索引器相比，每token的训练计算量减少了约6倍。在Llama-3.1-8B上，它比更强的32K运行落后0.6困惑度，在64K时简单的位置压缩往往效果同样好，因此主要收益在于训练成本而非质量。我们还对索引器键进行3-4位量化，无需重新训练，并使用融合整数核进行评分：在4位时，困惑度变化不超过0.05，扫描速度比半精度快1.6-2.2倍。在当前服务引擎中，索引器仅对具有多个并发流的长上下文解码加速。

articles.title: How Reliable is AI-Generated Audio Description? A Multilingual Expert Evaluation
articles.abstract: Audio description (AD) makes visual media, such as video, accessible to blind or low-vision (BLV) audiences, but the high cost of professional production limits coverage. Due to recent advances in AI, numerous approaches to automatically generate intermediate AD scripts and/or final AD audios have been proposed. We present an expert evaluation of AI-generated AD scripts for movies in Italian and German that compares two AI systems, a GPT-4o- and a Qwen-based pipeline, against human-authored descriptions. Professional audio describers rated description quality and annotated errors using a detailed error taxonomy that includes content, character, fluency and coherence errors. The results show that while GPT-4o outperforms the Qwen models, both AI systems still fall short of human professional quality: the generated descriptions show substantially higher error rates and lower quality ratings. Based on the error annotations, we identify two key areas that require improvement: 1) character references, which includes both issues with identification and coherent naming, and 2) content errors and hallucinations, where the AD misrepresents or invents events. These error types are particularly critical, as they directly affect the viewer's ability to follow the narrative.
articles.titleCn: AI生成音频描述有多可靠？一项多语言专家评估
articles.abstractCn: 音频描述（AD）使盲人或低视力（BLV）观众能够接触视频等视觉媒体，但专业制作的高成本限制了覆盖范围。由于人工智能的近期进展，已提出多种自动生成中间AD脚本和/或最终AD音频的方法。我们针对意大利语和德语电影中的AI生成AD脚本进行了专家评估，比较了基于GPT-4o和Qwen的两种AI系统与人类编写的描述。专业音频描述员使用包含内容、角色、流畅性和连贯性错误的详细错误分类法对描述质量进行评分并标注错误。结果显示，虽然GPT-4o优于Qwen模型，但两种AI系统仍未能达到人类专业水平：生成的描述显示出显著更高的错误率和更低的评分。基于错误标注，我们确定了需要改进的两个关键领域：1）角色指代，包括识别问题和连贯命名问题；2）内容错误和幻觉，即AD错误地描述或虚构事件。这些错误类型尤其关键，因为它们直接影响观众理解叙事的能力。

articles.title: Which Loopholes Get Found? Predicting Reward Hacking of LLM Judges Before RL Training
articles.abstract: A policy trained against an LLM judge can learn to exploit its loopholes. Static probes show that such judges accept degenerate answers like a lone "{" or "Thought process:", but not which flaw a policy will find. In GRPO the first loophole to be exploited can be predicted before training from each pattern's exposure, the product of the starting policy's propensity to produce it and the judge's false-positive rate (FPR). To test exposure causally, we seed the patterns into fine-tuning at three doses in a Latin square. Across 36 GRPO runs with seven judges, the first exploited pattern had the highest exposure in all 12 runs with exploitation and the highest FPR in only 6. Predictions recorded before training held in three of four runs with one pattern masked by rule. When only two patterns were seeded, at 3% to 3.8% of the fine-tuning data and chosen so that exposure disagreed with FPR alone or propensity alone, exposure named the first exploited pattern and its onset window in all six runs. Exploitation occurred only on hard prompts, where an accepted exploit gets a large group-normalized advantage. Auditing exposure before RL therefore identifies the loophole a policy will likely exploit first.

articles.titleCn: 哪些漏洞会被发现？在强化学习训练前预测大型语言模型裁判的奖励破解
articles.abstractCn: 针对LLM裁判器训练的策略可以学会利用其漏洞。静态探测显示，此类裁判器会接受如单独的"{"或"思考过程："等退化答案，但不会指出策略会发现哪个缺陷。在GRPO中，可利用的第一个漏洞可以在训练前根据每个模式的暴露情况预测，这是起始策略产生该模式的倾向性与裁判器的假阳性率（FPR）的乘积。为因果地测试暴露，我们将模式以三种剂量在拉丁方格中注入微调。在七名裁判器的36次GRPO运行中，在12次存在利用的情况下，首次被利用的模式在所有运行中都具有最高的暴露度，而在6次运行中具有最高的FPR。训练前的预测在四分之三的运行中成立，其中有一个模式被规则隐藏。当只注入两种模式时，占微调数据的3%至3.8%，且选择使暴露与FPR单独或倾向性单独不一致的模式，在所有六次运行中，暴露指明了首次被利用的模式及其启动窗口。利用仅发生在困难提示上，其中被接受的利用会获得较大的组归一化优势。因此，在强化学习前审计暴露，可以识别策略可能首先利用的漏洞。

articles.title: Reducing Authorship Attribution Risk in Student Texts Through Style-Conditioned Rewriting
articles.abstract: Building NLP applications for education is constrained by data scarcity due to student privacy concerns and data regulations. To address this, we propose a style-aware approach to rewriting student forum posts that retains analytical value while reducing identifiability. Our method isolates content, structure, and style as separate conditioning channels and aggregates over student-disjoint exemplar partitions within style clusters, extending Differentially Private In-context Learning (DP-ICL) with cluster-restricted retrieval. Across three educational NLP datasets, our approach achieves high style fidelity, preserves downstream task performance, and reduces authorship attribution risk relative to the original student-written texts, including against a dedicated authorship-attribution model.
articles.titleCn: 通过风格条件重写降低学生文本的作者归属风险
articles.abstractCn: 由于学生隐私问题和数据法规，为教育领域构建自然语言处理应用受到数据稀缺性的限制。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种风格感知的文本重写方法，该方法在保留分析价值的同时降低可识别性。我们的方法将内容、结构和风格作为独立的条件通道进行隔离，并在风格簇内的学生互斥示例分区上进行聚合，通过引入簇限制检索扩展了差分隐私情境学习（DP-ICL）。在三个教育自然语言处理数据集上，我们的方法实现了高风格保真度，保留了下游任务的性能，并相较于原始学生撰写的文本降低了作者归属风险，包括针对一个专门的作者归属模型。

articles.title: Diversity in Unity, Theory in Practice: Hierarchical Multitask Benchmarks for Chinese Minority Languages
articles.abstract: Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, their performance on linguistically and culturally diverse minority languages within a unified national context remains underexplored. We present CMiLBench, a collection of hierarchical multitask benchmarks designed to translate theoretical notions of "diversity in unity" into practical evaluation for three representative Chinese minority languages: Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur. CMiLBench comprises 24,663 instances across 5 difficulty levels and 17 tasks spanning foundational ability, cultural specificity, and safety alignment. We adopt existing dataset adaptation, minority knowledge construction, and high-resource benchmark translation to construct CMiLBench. We assess 14 state-of-the-art commercial and open-source LLMs with a hybrid framework that integrates automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. The comparative experimental results reveal the gap between theoretical capability and practical utility. CMiLBench serves as a foundational and scalable evaluation resource to bridge the digital language divide and promote the informatization and intelligentization of low-resource Chinese minority languages.
articles.comment: Camera-Ready Version; Accepted at ACL 2026
articles.titleCn: 多元一体，理论与实践：汉语少数民族语言的层次式多任务基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）发展迅速，但在统一国家背景下，针对语言和文化多样性少数民族语言的表现仍缺乏深入研究。我们提出了CMiLBench，这是一个分层的多任务基准集合，旨在将“多元一体”的理论概念转化为对三种代表性中国少数民族语言——藏语、蒙古语和维吾尔语——的实用评估。CMiLBench包含24,663个实例，分为5个难度级别，涵盖17项任务，涉及基础能力、文化特异性和安全对齐。我们采用现有的数据集适配、少数民族知识构建和高资源基准翻译方法来构建CMiLBench。我们采用混合框架，结合自动指标和LLM作为裁判的评分方法，评估了14个最先进的商业和开源LLMs。比较实验结果表明了理论能力与实践效用之间的差距。CMiLBench作为一个基础且可扩展的评估资源，旨在弥合数字语言鸿沟，促进低资源中国少数民族语言的信息化和智能化发展。

articles.title: Explainable Emotion and Mental Health Reasoning in Large Language Models Using Theories of Emotion
articles.abstract: Advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a wide range of applications. However, their ability to simulate human-like behavior and reasoning remains unclear. While emotion detection is a better-established Natural Language Processing (NLP) task, existing approaches primarily focus on directly classifying text into predefined emotion classes, often overlooking the appraisal process that explains why an individual experiences a particular emotion in a given situation. In this work, we propose Psychology-based Chain-of-Thought (PsyCoT) reasoning, a theory-driven prompting strategy grounded in the Schachter-Singer and Cognitive Appraisal theories of emotion. We propose and evaluate PsyCoT for subjective NLP tasks, including emotion analysis, emotion intensity prediction, stress analysis, and depression severity identification. Our evaluation covers four levels of classification complexity: binary, multiclass, multi-label, and ordinal scaling, spanning 11 languages. We assess the performance of five state-of-the-art LLMs across these selected subjective NLP tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that PsyCoT prompt variants improve the standard chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting across the evaluated tasks. Across all evaluated tasks, PsyCoT yields F1 score gains ranging from 0.5% to 28.1%, depending on the model, task, and language configuration.

articles.titleCn: 基于情绪理论对大型语言模型中可解释的情绪与心理健康推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的进步催生了广泛的应用。然而，它们模拟人类行为和推理的能力仍不明确。虽然情绪检测是更成熟的自然语言处理（NLP）任务，但现有方法主要集中于直接将文本分类到预定义的情绪类别中，往往忽略了评估过程，而评估过程解释了个体在特定情境中为何会体验到某种情绪。在这项工作中，我们提出了基于心理学的思维链（PsyCoT）推理，这是一种以理论为驱动、基于施瓦茨-辛格和认知评估情绪理论的提示策略。我们提出了评估PsyCoT在主观NLP任务中的应用，包括情绪分析、情绪强度预测、压力分析和抑郁严重程度识别。我们的评估涵盖了四种分类复杂度级别：二元分类、多类分类、多标签分类和序数标度，涉及11种语言。我们评估了五种最先进的LLM在这些选定的主观NLP任务中的表现。实验结果表明，PsyCoT提示变体在评估的任务中提升了标准思维链（CoT）提示的效果。在所有评估的任务中，PsyCoT的F1分数提升范围从0.5%到28.1%，具体取决于模型、任务和语言配置。

articles.title: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
articles.abstract: Efficient AI computation depends on hardware that evolves over time, shifting the strategies needed to implement performant code. For CPU kernels, a key evolving factor is the set of available architectural extensions, which expose specialized hardware instructions that change the techniques used to optimize kernels. We study how effectively coding agents use these new, potentially unfamiliar extensions to write fast code. We introduce KernelShift, a benchmarking pipeline and a set of environments for evaluating coding agents in kernel optimization across evolving CPU architectures. Its agent-assisted, human-verified pipeline turns code repositories into benchmark instances, and its environments let agents optimize code with feedback from the target hardware. Using this pipeline, we construct 99 kernels from real-world, actively developed repositories (ncnn, llama.cpp, Arm SIMD Loops, and KleidiAI), including inference workloads derived from real model executions. KernelShift supports incorporating new kernels and hardware configurations as libraries and processors evolve. We evaluate agents with proprietary and open-weight models across progressively newer architectural extensions (Arm Neon, SVE, SVE2, and SME2), examining how performance changes as hardware evolves. On established extensions, agents beat the auto-vectorized compiler everywhere (2.4-19.8x) and exceed general-purpose libraries such as ncnn (getting up to 2.74x over its Neon kernels), but fall behind Arm's hand-tuned KleidiAI kernels (0.70x). In end-to-end inference of two LLMs, agent-written kernels achieve a 1.3-1.6x prefill speedup over llama.cpp's fast path. However, current agents do not yet reliably adapt to new extensions that require unfamiliar programming models, such as SME2's matrix tiles.

articles.titleCn: KernelShift：跨不断发展的硬件进行核优化基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 高效的AI计算依赖于随时间演进的硬件，这使得实现高性能代码的策略也随之变化。对于CPU内核而言，一个关键的演进因素是可用的架构扩展集，这些扩展集提供了专用硬件指令，从而改变了优化内核的技术。我们研究了编码代理如何有效地使用这些新且可能不熟悉的扩展来编写快速代码。我们引入了KernelShift，这是一个用于评估编码代理在演进CPU架构下内核优化能力的基准测试流程和一组环境。其代理辅助、人工验证的流程将代码仓库转化为基准实例，其环境允许代理在目标硬件的反馈下优化代码。利用该流程，我们从真实世界的活跃开发仓库（ncnn、llama.cpp、Arm SIMD Loops和KleidiAI）中构建了99个内核，包括从真实模型执行中推导出的推理工作负载。KernelShift支持随着库和处理器的发展而整合新的内核和硬件配置。我们使用专有和开源权重模型，在逐步更新的架构扩展（Arm Neon、SVE、SVE2和SME2）上评估代理，考察硬件演进时性能的变化。在成熟的扩展上，代理在所有情况下都超越了自动向量化编译器（提升2.4-19.8倍），并超过了通用库如ncnn（在其Neon内核上最高提升2.74倍），但落后于Arm手工调优的KleidiAI内核（仅提升0.70倍）。在两个LLM的端到端推理中，代理编写的内核在prefill速度上比llama.cpp的快速路径提升了1.3-1.6倍。然而，当前的代理尚未可靠地适应需要不熟悉编程模型的新扩展，例如SME2的矩阵瓦片。

articles.title: Single-Coordinate Activation Steering for Controllable Social Stance in Language Models
articles.abstract: Steering one neuron of a small language model can impose a topic or a quirk without training, yet replications show that many published single-neuron recipes are fragile or nonspecific. This paper asks whether an interpersonal stance can be controlled in this manner. The stance studied is a distant crush, a chatbot character that is guarded, intermittently warm and inconsistent. In Qwen3.5, 4B, contrasting activations on hand-written guarded and eager replies identified neuron 7515 of layer 9 as a candidate for controlling this stance. Increasing this neuron activation made the characters replies more distant. Three language models rated this change as stronger than the effects of changing randomly selected neurons, and a blind human comparison supported the finding. Changing the interventions direction between messages also shifted replies between warmer and more distant styles. This suggests that a language model conversational stance can be personalized without finetuning.
articles.titleCn: 单坐标激活引导语言模型中的可控社会立场
articles.abstractCn: 对小型语言模型中的一个神经元进行操控，可以在未经训练的情况下赋予其特定主题或怪癖，然而重复实验表明，许多已发表的单一神经元操控方法要么脆弱，要么缺乏特异性。本文探讨了是否可以通过类似方式控制人际立场。所研究的立场是一种疏远的暗恋，即一个守口如瓶、时而温暖且前后不一致的聊天机器人角色。在Qwen3.5、4B模型中，通过对比手写守口如瓶回复和急切回复的激活状态，识别出第9层的7515号神经元作为控制这种立场的候选神经元。增加该神经元的激活程度使角色回复更显疏远。三个语言模型均评定这种改变的效果强于随机选择神经元改变的效果，且盲法人类比较结果支持了这一发现。在消息间改变干预方向也会使回复风格在更温暖和更疏远之间转换。这表明，语言模型的对话立场可以在不进行微调的情况下进行个性化。

articles.title: LM2 Compiling a Language Model into Another Model Weights
articles.abstract: Deploying a conversational model and a specialist together could avoid maintaining a separate specialist service. We present LM2, which embeds a trained story generator into a larger conversational model. The larger model handles the conversation and invokes the generator for story requests. We constrain the generator arithmetic during training so its calculations can be compiled directly into added model layers. We compare this approach with QwenPU, which executes the stories260K language model on an embedded processor. LM2 requires one host token per generated character, compared with approximately 25,000 for QwenPU. However, its story generator predicts held out text less well, i.e. 1.145 bits per character versus 0.894 for stories260K, where lower is better. The Qwen3.5, 0.8B implementation occupies 18.1 GB and generates the same characters as a standalone integer implementation of the inner model in the tested runs. These results illustrate a tradeoff between host-token cost and text-prediction performance.
articles.titleCn: 将语言模型编译成另一种模型权重
articles.abstractCn: 将对话模型和专家系统结合部署可以避免维护独立的专家服务。我们提出了LM2，它将一个训练好的故事生成器嵌入到更大的对话模型中。大型模型负责处理对话，并在需要故事时调用生成器。我们在训练过程中对生成器的算术运算进行约束，使其计算可以直接编译为模型的新增层。我们将这种方法与QwenPU进行了比较，后者在一个嵌入式处理器上执行故事260K语言模型。LM2每个生成的字符需要一个主机令牌，而QwenPU则需要大约25,000个。然而，其故事生成器在预测未包含文本方面的表现较差，即每个字符1.145比特，而故事260K为0.894比特（越低越好）。Qwen3.5，0.8B实现占用18.1 GB内存，并在测试运行中生成的字符数量与内部模型的独立整数实现相同。这些结果说明了主机令牌成本和文本预测性能之间的权衡。

articles.title: CompareDR: Benchmarking Deep Research Reports from Individual Quality to Comparative Merit
articles.abstract: Deep research systems can produce reports with different evidence, analyses, and conclusions for the same query. A reader deciding which findings to rely on needs to know how well each report meets the task requirements and which differences matter to the answer. A score for a single report can summarize its quality, but it does not identify which contributions make one report more useful than another. We introduce CompareDR, a benchmark that combines task-specific pointwise audits with guideline-based pairwise comparisons. We use passage-linked report representations to locate relevant differences and selective evidence verification to check claims that could affect the judgment. The benchmark comprises 40 Chinese and English tasks from three existing benchmarks, 360 reports from nine systems, 1,099 human-reviewed evaluation criteria, and human preferences elicited through blinded comparisons of 80 report pairs. The hybrid evaluator matches 69 of these 80 preferences (86.25%, Cohen's $κ=0.746$). The benchmark supports both comparisons of research systems and examination of the evidence and analyses behind those judgments.
articles.titleCn: CompareDR：从个体质量到比较优势，对深度研究报告进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究系统能够针对同一查询生成包含不同证据、分析和结论的报告。读者在决定依赖哪些发现时，需要了解每份报告如何满足任务要求，以及哪些差异对答案有影响。单一报告的评分可以总结其质量，但无法识别哪些贡献使一份报告比另一份更有用。我们介绍了CompareDR，这是一个结合了任务特定逐点审核和基于指南的成对比较的基准。我们使用段落关联的报告表示来定位相关差异，并采用选择性证据验证来检查可能影响判断的声明。该基准包含来自三个现有基准的40个中文和英文任务，9个系统的360份报告，1099个人审阅的评价标准，以及通过盲法比较80对报告所引出的个人偏好。混合评估器匹配了其中80个偏好中的69个（86.25%，Cohen's $κ=0.746$）。该基准支持研究系统的比较，以及审查这些判断背后的证据和分析。

articles.title: Estimating Silenced Tokens in Quantized LLMs
articles.abstract: Quantization is the standard way to shrink large language models, and it is usually judged by perplexity and task accuracy. We ask a different question: after quantization, which words can the model still say at all? A token is silenced when no hidden state can make it the top choice of the output layer, so a greedy decoder can never produce it. We give a simple, scalable way to estimate how many tokens a quantized output head silences, combining three checks: a direction that lets a token win (so it is safe), an upper bound on how close a token's row is to being trapped inside the others, and an exact match that proves a token can never win. Each count is therefore a certified range: exact matches give its lower end and flagged tokens can only raise its upper end. In nearly all settings we report down to 3 bits the two ends coincide, so the counts are exact. Across three open models we find that quantization silences tokens: on large-vocabulary models it already appears at 8-bit precision, up to a few hundred previously reachable tokens on a 1B-parameter model, and grows as precision drops, while a small-vocabulary model resists until 3 bits. The loss is far from uniform across languages: on a multilingual vocabulary the silenced tokens are overwhelmingly non-Latin (Korean, Chinese, Thai, Arabic and Hebrew), even though Latin tokens dominate the vocabulary. Silencing is thus a measurable, language-sensitive side effect that standard averages miss, and it should be reported alongside them.
articles.comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables
articles.titleCn: 量化LLMs中的静默标记估计
articles.abstractCn: 量化是压缩大型语言模型的常用方法，通常通过困惑度和任务准确度来评估。我们提出了一个不同的问题：量化后，模型还能说出哪些词？当一个词没有任何隐藏状态能使其成为输出层的首选时，它就会被“沉默”，因此贪婪解码器永远无法生成它。我们提供了一种简单且可扩展的方法来估计量化输出头沉默了多少个词，结合了三个检查：一个让词获胜的方向（使其安全），一个词的行接近被其他行困住的上限，以及一个证明词永远无法获胜的精确匹配。因此每个计数都是一个认证范围：精确匹配给出其下限，而标记的词只能提高其上限。在我们报告的几乎所有情况下，当精度降至3位时，两个端点重合，因此计数是精确的。在三个公开模型中，我们发现量化沉默了词：在大词汇模型中，量化在8位精度时就已经出现，在1B参数模型上，高达几百个之前可达的词被沉默，并且随着精度的降低而增加，而小词汇模型则直到3位精度才出现沉默。损失在不同语言中差异很大：在一个多语言词汇中，被沉默的词绝大多数是非拉丁文（韩文、中文、泰文、阿拉伯文和希伯来文），尽管拉丁文词在词汇中占主导地位。因此，沉默是一种可测量且与语言相关的副作用，标准平均值会忽略它，应该与它们一起报告。

articles.title: Adaptation or Poisoning? Security Risks of Conversational Test-Time Learning in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Test-time learning (TTL) enables large language models to adapt to unlabeled inputs during deployment. The model updates a lightweight adapter by minimizing the next-token prediction loss on the input it receives. When these updates persist across conversation turns, every user query serves both as the request answered in the current turn and as adaptation data for later turns. By choosing the queries used for adaptation, an attacker can influence parameter updates and weaken safety alignment through ordinary interactions with a TTL chat service. To demonstrate this risk, we introduce Progressive Test-Time Adaptation Poisoning (P-TAP), a query-only multi-turn attack that jailbreaks the model by poisoning its session adapter through the service's own updates. A sequence of escalating adversarial queries shapes the adapter turn by turn; the final harmful request is then answered under the accumulated state without itself being used for adaptation. Across four open-weight instruction-tuned models, enabling updates raises attack success rates on average by 13.00 percentage points under greedy decoding and by 22.25 points under best-of-10 sampling, relative to matched sessions receiving the same queries without updates. Answering adversarial queries but adapting on unrelated text or on benign text about the same topic removes most of this increase. Among existing safeguards, screening incoming queries flags every attack stream before the final request, while a perplexity-based detector of unsafe adaptation flags none of the successful attacks.

articles.titleCn: 适应性还是毒性？大型语言模型中对话测试时学习的安全风险
articles.abstractCn: 测试时学习（TTL）使大型语言模型能够在部署过程中适应未标记的输入。模型通过最小化接收到的输入上的下一词预测损失来更新轻量级适配器。当这些更新跨对话回合持续时，每个用户查询既作为当前回合的回答请求，也作为后续回合的适应数据。通过选择用于适应的查询，攻击者可以通过与TTL聊天服务的普通交互来影响参数更新，从而削弱安全对齐。为了证明这一风险，我们引入了渐进式测试时适应中毒（P-TAP），这是一种仅使用查询的多回合攻击，通过服务自身的更新来破坏模型，使其会话适配器中毒。一系列逐步升级的对抗性查询逐回合塑造适配器；然后，在累积的状态下回答最终的恶意请求，而该请求本身并未用于适应。在四个开放权重指令微调模型中，启用更新在贪婪解码下平均使攻击成功率提高了13.00个百分点，在最佳10次采样下提高了22.25个百分点，相对于接收相同查询但未启用更新的匹配会话。回答对抗性查询但在无关文本或关于同一主题的良性文本上进行适应，可以消除大部分这种增长。在现有的防护措施中，筛选传入查询会在最终请求之前标记每个攻击流，而基于困惑度的不安全适应检测器则未标记任何成功的攻击。

articles.title: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
articles.abstract: Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. A language model can author useful changes to its own weights without gradients, and the edited model keeps writing useful edits.
articles.titleCn: 递归自我编辑：大型语言模型自行编程权重编辑以实现自我改进
articles.abstractCn: 递归自我改进要求系统改进其自身改进的系统。当今的语言模型通过数据、训练配方或脚手架来改进自身。每当它们的权重发生变化时，梯度下降会写入更新，而不是模型本身。我们让模型自行编写其权重。在SELFWRITE中，每一代，当前模型都会在新的训练问题上研究其自身的推理，在持久的Python会话中检查其自身的权重和激活，并编写一个程序，该程序使用白盒原语（奇异方向、其正确和错误答案之间的激活对比、秩一投影、张量计算）构建一个低秩权重编辑，而无需任何训练或梯度工具。每个候选方案都会在针对当前模型的隐藏门控集上进行一次评分；严格改进的最佳编辑将被合并到权重中，并由编辑后的模型编写下一个编辑。在Qwen3.8-27B和DAPO-Math的数学问题上，五代的SELFWRITE将门控准确率从73.95%提高到76.45%，从未被循环看到的保留测试集上的准确率从76.30%提高到77.75%（avg@4）和从82.60%提高到84.80%（pass@4），而无需一个梯度步。语言模型可以在没有梯度的情况下自行编写对其自身权重的有用更改，并且编辑后的模型会持续编写有用的编辑。

articles.title: Meddies-PII: A Multilingual Framework for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction in Clinical De-identification
articles.abstract: Multilingual PII extraction in clinical text is limited by scarce governed data and by synthetic corpora whose construction is thinly documented. We present a large multilingual dataset covering seventeen languages, including seven Southeast Asian languages, and nine PII labels. We also document a detailed generation pipeline and release the complete prompts, catalogues, checks and label maps. A compact 350M-parameter BIOES token classifier trained on the resource achieves the highest score on all fifteen public benchmarks, significantly ahead of the strongest of four public systems on fourteen of them, with a mean exact-match F1 of 0.827 against 0.672 for the strongest system. We also tested it, without adaptation, on multilingual benchmarks, including two human-annotated German and Spanish clinical-style corpora, where it is competitive with the best public systems once annotation conventions are aligned, and is best in four of ten MultiGraSCCo languages; the results show that performance transfers across public benchmarks. We also analyse the data and find almost no near-duplicates and no text overlap between training and any evaluation set. The dataset, benchmark, model, generation framework and evaluation code are planned for public release upon acceptance.
articles.titleCn: Meddies-PII：一种用于临床去识别中个人信息提取的多语言框架
articles.abstractCn: 在临床文本中进行多语言个人信息提取受到受管治数据稀缺和合成语料库构建记录不详细的双重限制。我们提出一个包含十七种语言（包括七种东南亚语言）和九种个人信息标签的大规模多语言数据集。我们还详细记录了生成流程，并发布了完整的提示、目录、检查和标签映射。一个基于该资源训练的紧凑型350M参数BIOES标记分类器在所有十五个公开基准测试中均取得了最高分数，在十四个基准测试中显著领先于四个公开系统中表现最强的系统，其平均精确匹配F1分数为0.827，而最强系统的F1分数为0.672。我们还未经调整地在多语言基准测试中测试了该模型，包括两个人类标注的德语和西班牙语临床风格语料库，一旦标注规范一致，它在表现上与最佳公开系统相当，并在十个MultiGraSCCo语言的四分之一中表现最佳；结果表明性能可以在公开基准测试之间迁移。我们还分析了数据，发现几乎不存在近似重复，且训练集与任何评估集之间没有文本重叠。该数据集、基准测试、模型、生成框架和评估代码计划在录用后公开发布。

articles.title: GraphSeer: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Relational Image Retrieval with MLLMs
articles.abstract: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) store entities with photos and names and link them by facts. MMKG methods predict links between known entity IDs, and image retrievers, from CLIP to MLLM embedders, return entities that look like a query photo or match its description. Neither answers a common question about a new photo: which graph entity is related to the one shown, such as the team of a pictured player or the city of a landmark. We call this knowledge graph relational image retrieval (KRIR): given a photo and a natural-language relation, retrieve the related MMKG entity, which rarely resembles the photo, whether the depicted entity is in the graph (known) or not (unseen). We build three benchmarks from YAGO, Wikidata and in-the-wild OVEN photos. The task hides two hops: recognising which graph entity is shown, and recalling what it is connected to. GraphSeer bridges them inside one multimodal LLM: it links the photo to the graph, reads the facts of the best match, and retrieves with the hidden state at which the model is about to say the answer. An unseen entity has no facts of its own, but every candidate answer does, so a listwise verifier reads the other end of the graph: it re-ranks the top candidates by their facts and photos in one forward pass, and the facts matter far more than the photos. With Qwen3.5-27B, GraphSeer improves MRR on known entities by 24.2-70.0% over an MLLM embedder fine-tuned on the same data with the same budget. When it also fuses and verifies the embedder's candidates, it improves MRR on unseen entities by 12.5-25.6%, and on known entities it beats KG-completion models given the ground-truth entity ID.
articles.titleCn: 图塞尔：基于多模态知识图谱关系图像检索的多模态语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 多模态知识图谱（MMKGs）存储带有照片和名称的实体，并通过事实将它们相互链接。MMKG方法预测已知实体ID之间的链接，而图像检索器，从CLIP到MLLM嵌入器，返回与查询照片相似或与其描述匹配的实体。它们都不能回答关于新照片的常见问题：显示的图实体与哪个实体相关，例如照片中球员的团队或地标所在的城市。我们称这种知识图谱关系图像检索（KRIR）为：给定一张照片和自然语言关系，检索与之相关的MMKG实体，该实体很少与照片相似，无论所描绘的实体是否存在于图谱中（已知）或不存在（未见）。我们从YAGO、Wikidata和自然场景中的OVEN照片构建了三个基准数据集。该任务隐藏了两个步骤：识别图中显示的实体，以及回忆它与什么相连。GraphSeer将它们连接在一个多模态LLM内部：它将照片链接到图谱，读取最佳匹配的事实，并使用模型即将说出答案时的隐藏状态进行检索。未见实体没有自己的事实，但每个候选答案都有，因此一个列表验证器会读取图谱的另一端：它通过一次正向传递重新排序顶级候选答案，根据它们的事实和照片，事实证明事实比照片重要得多。使用Qwen3.5-27B，GraphSeer在已知实体上的MRR比在相同数据集和相同预算下微调的MLLM嵌入器提高了24.2-70.0%。当它还融合并验证嵌入器的候选答案时，它在未见实体上的MRR提高了12.5-25.6%，并且在已知实体上，它优于给定真实实体ID的KG补全模型。

articles.title: Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. Across ten LLM agents, we find that stronger agents outperform both adaptive (Bayesian optimization) and non-adaptive (Latin hypercube) baselines and exhibit exploration patterns inconsistent with naive heuristics. Decomposing reasoning reveals that the stronger agents score consistently well across all four steps, whereas weaker agents often succeed at belief update and hypothesis discrimination but are less reliable at translating them into actionable designs and sharp contrastive predictions. Independent expert annotations support predictive reasoning under our stated validation criteria, while evidence for discriminative experiment design is positive but less consistent. The results suggest a gap between recognizing plausible hypotheses and translating them into contrastive predictions, with more tentative evidence for a corresponding experiment-design bottleneck. The benchmark website is available at https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/.

articles.titleCn: 超越准确性：面向大语言模型代理假设驱动实验规划的诊断基准
articles.abstractCn: 在科学任务上评估大型语言模型（LLM）代理通常简化为最终任务准确率，这掩盖了推理成功或失败的具体位置。我们引入了一个基准和诊断评估框架，用于假设驱动的自适应实验规划，应用于封闭世界系统识别，具体实例为动力学机制识别。该框架在两个方面超越了最终准确率。首先，我们通过量化代理在实验设计空间中表现出空间填充或角落寻找模式的程度来评估探索行为。其次，我们将推理过程分解为四个可解释的步骤：信念更新、假设区分、判别性实验设计和干预下的预测推理，每个步骤都在推理轨迹上单独评分。在十个LLM代理中，我们发现更强的代理优于自适应（贝叶斯优化）和非自适应（拉丁超立方）基线，并表现出与朴素启发式不一致的探索模式。分解推理表明，更强的代理在所有四个步骤中都得分稳定，而较弱的代理通常在信念更新和假设区分上成功，但在将它们转化为可执行设计和尖锐对比预测方面则不太可靠。独立专家标注支持我们提出的验证标准下的预测推理，而判别性实验设计的证据为正但一致性较低。结果表明，在识别合理假设和将其转化为对比预测之间存在差距，更有证据表明存在相应的实验设计瓶颈。基准网站可在 https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/ 访问。

articles.title: MAS-BIT: A Multi-Agent System for End-to-End BraIn-to-Text Decoding
articles.abstract: Speech brain-computer interfaces aim to restore communication by translating neural activity into text, yet end-to-end decoders have historically trailed cascaded systems in accuracy. We introduce a Multi-Agent System for BraIn-to-Text (MAS-BIT), the first multi-agent framework for end-to-end brain-to-text decoding from intracortical recordings. MAS-BIT coordinates three specialized agents: a neural agent that interprets continuous neural representations, a phonetic agent that decodes soft phoneme posteriors, and an arbitration agent that integrates their complementary evidence with direct access to neural representations to generate the final transcription. The expert agents communicate with the arbiter through token-embedding-based latent communication, constructing continuous messages as probability-weighted combinations of token embeddings. These messages retain alternative token hypotheses and provide a differentiable interface through which sentence-level supervision jointly trains the neural encoders and specialized agents across participants. MAS-BIT achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end decoding performance on the Brain-to-Text '24 and '25 benchmarks, with word error rates of 6.929% on '24 and 3.606% on the '25 public test set (3.892% on the private test set). These results surpass the published BIT cascade on the '25 public set and narrow the gap on '24, without ensembling independently trained models or using external language-model rescoring.
articles.titleCn: MAS-BIT：一种用于端到端脑机接口到文本解码的多智能体系统
articles.abstractCn: 脑机接口旨在通过将神经活动转化为文本来恢复通信，但端到端解码器在准确性上一直落后于级联系统。我们引入了一种用于脑到文本端到端解码的多智能体系统——脑到文本多智能体系统（MAS-BIT），这是首个基于皮层内记录的脑到文本端到端解码的多智能体框架。MAS-BIT协调三个专门智能体：一个神经智能体解释连续神经表征，一个语音学智能体解码软音素后验概率，以及一个仲裁智能体整合它们互补的证据并直接访问神经表征以生成最终转录。专家智能体通过基于标记嵌入的潜在通信与仲裁者交流，构建连续消息作为概率加权的标记嵌入组合。这些消息保留了替代标记假设，并提供了一个可微分的接口，通过句子级监督联合训练神经编码器和专门智能体跨参与者。MAS-BIT在Brain-to-Text '24和'25基准测试中实现了最先进的端到端解码性能，在'24公共测试集上单词错误率为6.929%，在'25公共测试集上为3.606%（私有测试集上为3.892%）。这些结果超越了'25公共集上发布的BIT级联系统，并在'24上缩小了差距，而无需集成独立训练的模型或使用外部语言模型重评分。

articles.title: PAWP-TTS: Phoneme-Aware Weight Programming for Compact Bilingual English-Nepali Speech Synthesis
articles.abstract: This paper presents PAWP-TTS, a compact non-autoregressive text-to-speech system for English, Nepali, and English-Nepali code-mixed speech at 24 kHz, with no language model at inference. Deterministic pronunciation knowledge lives in a rule- and lexicon-based bilingual frontend that preserves native Nepali contrasts and avoids Hindi phonology, so the network only models acoustics. Counting every learned inference tensor, including the waveform decoder, PAWP-1.5M (1,490,390 parameters, 5.98 MB) reaches 1.50% English and 1.75% Nepali character error rate under a single ASR recognizer, and 5.04% / 4.02% Nepali / English phoneme error rate (PER) on 600 untouched test utterances. Decoder-centric 281K-parameter models (1.1 MB) stay intelligible across three independent seeds, with equal-budget dense models (5.53 +/- 0.08% NE, 5.34 +/- 0.28% EN PER) outperforming K=2 cross-layer shared-basis models (6.35 +/- 0.11% NE, 6.57 +/- 0.47% EN PER). Fixing a frontend/label version mismatch nearly halved Nepali PER, more than any architectural or weight-level change. The paper then studies weight-space programming: inspection-guided, zero-training weight edits. Under strict controls (validation-only selection, one-shot test, paired bootstrap, matched random and same-parameter gradient baselines), edits show real selectivity (27:1 on word-boundary pauses with 96 weights; zero cross-lingual collateral inside language-gated residuals) but no accuracy gain beyond controls. Two apparent targets proved to be label or phonology artifacts. Code, ONNX graphs, and CC BY 4.0 weights are released.
articles.comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Code: https://github.com/Firojpaudel/PAWP_TTS | Audio Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Firoj112/pawp-tts-demo | Models: https://huggingface.co/Firoj112/pawp-tts-1.5m and https://huggingface.co/Firoj112/pawp-tts-300k
articles.titleCn: PAWP-TTS：针对紧凑型英尼泊尔双语语音合成设计的音素感知权重编程
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了PAWP-TTS，一种适用于英语、尼泊尔语和英语-尼泊尔语混合语音的紧凑型非自回归文本到语音系统，采样率为24 kHz，推理时无需语言模型。确定性发音知识存在于基于规则和词汇的双语前端，该前端保留了尼泊尔语的本土语音对比并避免了印地语语音系统，因此网络仅对声学进行建模。计算所有学习过的推理张量，包括波形解码器，PAWP-1.5M（1,490,390参数，5.98 MB）在单个语音识别器下达到1.50%的英语和1.75%的尼泊尔语字符错误率，以及在600个未接触的测试语音上5.04% / 4.02%的尼泊尔语/英语音素错误率（PER）。以解码器为中心的281K参数模型（1.1 MB）在三个独立种子上保持可懂度，同等预算的密集模型（5.53 +/- 0.08% NE，5.34 +/- 0.28% EN PER）优于K=2的跨层共享基模型（6.35 +/- 0.11% NE，6.57 +/- 0.47% EN PER）。修正前端/标签版本不匹配几乎将尼泊尔语PER减半，超过了任何架构或权重级别的变化。本文随后研究了权重空间编程：指导性、零训练的权重编辑。在严格控制下（仅验证选择、单次测试、配对自举、匹配随机和相同参数梯度基线），编辑显示出真正的选择性（在词边界停顿上为27:1，96个权重；语言门控残差内无跨语言附带影响），但未在控制之外带来准确率提升。两个明显目标被证明是标签或语音学的伪影。代码、ONNX图和CC BY 4.0权重已公开。

articles.title: Detectable Epistemic Attack Layers: A Coverage Theorem and Standardized Harness for Conversation-History Integrity
articles.abstract: Conversation history is infrastructure: deployed language models rely on application layers to store and reinject prior turns, and that stored state is writable. We formalize session-level contamination by attack layer, state a coverage theorem, and measure its scope: each deployment-layer verification tier covers exactly its layer and is sound with respect to the others; instruction overrides are not detectable without false positives; and composite vectors evade per-fragment verification. A standardized harness applied to eight mechanism families across 3,249 sessions and three model families makes these claims checkable. First, pattern-based detection pays a measured false-positive price: the classic defenses flag 35 to 50 percent of benign sessions, and the naive refusal floor reaches only 2.4 percent attack-cell adoption while destroying 33 to 100 percent of benign turns, whereas provenance-gated channel separation achieves adoption at or below 1.2 percent with zero false positives and zero utility loss. Second, in the exploratory instruction-override extension, the gates' boundary is a cliff: directives rephrased without shape markers bypass them at control-equivalent rates, 47.7 to 49.5 percent against 0.0 percent for the shaped class, placing that class in the model-internal lane. Third, the deterministic core is storage-layer detection at 126 of 126 per model with zero false positives. External anchors reproduce published attack pressure, with PoisonedRAG falling from 70 to 0 percent under the full stack. For practitioners: authenticate stored history and content provenance with deterministic tiers, scope instruction-layer mitigation to provenance-gated designs whose measured benign cost is zero, and monitor composition at the trajectory level rather than per fragment. All protocols and acceptance criteria are pre-registered; the stack and harness are released.
articles.comment: 36 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Harness, protocol texts, and pre-registration: https://github.com/fahrellgiovanny/conversation-history-integrity
articles.titleCn: 可检测的认知攻击层：覆盖定理和对话历史完整性标准化适配器
articles.abstractCn: 对话历史是基础设施：部署的语言模型依赖于应用层来存储和重新注入先前的对话回合，而存储的状态是可写的。我们通过攻击层对会话级别的污染进行了形式化，陈述了一个覆盖定理，并测量了其范围：每个部署层的验证层仅覆盖其自身层级，并且与其他层保持一致性；指令覆盖无法在不产生误报的情况下检测到；复合向量可以规避逐片段验证。一个标准化的测试框架应用于跨越3,249个会话和三个模型家族的八个机制家族，使得这些声明可以被验证。首先，基于模式的检测付出了可测量的误报代价：经典防御会标记35%到50%的正常会话，而简单的拒绝策略的最低拒用率仅为2.4%的攻击单元采用率，同时摧毁了33%到100%的正常回合，而来源门控的通道隔离在1.2%或以下的采用率下实现了零误报和零效用损失。其次，在探索性指令覆盖扩展中，门控的边界是一堵悬崖：没有形状标记的指令重述以控制等价率绕过它们，47.7%到49.5%的攻击率对比形状类0.0%，将形状类置于模型内部通道。第三，确定性核心是存储层检测，在126个模型中的126个检测中实现了零误报。外部锚点重现了已发布的攻击压力，PoisonedRAG在完整堆栈下从70%降至0%。对实践者的建议：使用确定性层级验证存储的历史和内容来源，将指令层缓解范围限定于来源门控设计，其测量的良性成本为零，并在轨迹级别而非逐片段监控组合。所有协议和接受标准均已预先注册；堆栈和测试框架已公开发布。

articles.title: VistaTree: Question Answering over Long Multimodal Documents with Image-Derived Summary Trees
articles.abstract: Answering questions over long multimodal documents requires locating relevant evidence across pages containing text, tables, and figures. When the document exceeds the model's context window, selective retrieval becomes necessary. We introduce VistaTree, a document question-answering agent that builds a summary tree directly from rendered page images. VistaTree segments documents into contiguous page spans, recursively groups them into a topic hierarchy, and refines sibling summaries to distinguish neighboring sections. At query time, the agent uses node summaries to select relevant nodes and reads the corresponding pages, using hierarchical navigation when the full outline exceeds the context budget. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL evaluate answer quality and retrieval cost using a locally hosted vision-language model, and quantify the performance gap between global and hierarchical access to the index.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
articles.titleCn: VistaTree：基于图像生成摘要树对长多模态文档进行问答
articles.abstractCn: 回答跨越多模态长文档的问题需要定位包含文本、表格和图形的跨页相关证据。当文档超出模型的上下文窗口时，选择性检索变得必要。我们介绍了 VistaTree，这是一个直接从渲染的页面图像构建摘要树的文档问答代理。VistaTree 将文档分割成连续的页面片段，递归地将它们分组形成主题层次结构，并细化兄弟摘要以区分相邻章节。在查询时，代理使用节点摘要选择相关节点并读取相应页面，当完整大纲超出上下文预算时使用层次导航。在 MMLongBench-Doc 和 LongDocURL 上的实验评估了使用本地部署的视觉语言模型回答质量和检索成本，并量化了全局访问和层次访问索引之间的性能差距。

articles.title: HGDNA: Overlapping k-mer Tokenization for Efficient Autoregressive Genomic Language Models
articles.abstract: The domain of genomic language models (gLMs) has advanced rapidly, with models pretrained on diverse multi-species genomic corpora demonstrating their remarkable capabilities. While the effect of simple nucleotide-level tokenization on long-context modeling is well established, overlapping k-mer tokenization remains underexplored in causal pretraining, despite its rich neighborhood information. Here, we thoroughly revisit overlapping tokenization and introduce HGDNA, a hybrid linear-attention gLM with causal language modeling (CLM) pretraining and a shared token-prediction interface for downstream adaptation, using a species-classification auxiliary task and shared class tokens. HGDNA delivers competitive performance across sequence classification and frozen-embedding evaluations, supporting both short-range and long-range tasks with 30M parameters and 19B pretraining tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA
articles.titleCn: HGDNA：用于高效自回归基因组语言模型的k-mer重叠分词
articles.abstractCn: 基因组语言模型（gLM）领域发展迅速，基于多种物种基因组语料库预训练的模型展现出其卓越能力。尽管简单核苷酸级分词对长上下文建模的影响已得到充分验证，但重叠k-mer分词在因果预训练方面仍待探索，尽管其丰富的邻域信息。在此，我们重新深入研究了重叠分词，并引入了HGDNA，这是一种混合线性注意力gLM，采用因果语言模型（CLM）预训练，并具有共享的分词预测接口以适应下游任务，通过物种分类辅助任务和共享类别标记实现。HGDNA在序列分类和冻结嵌入评估中均表现出竞争力，仅需30M参数和19B预训练标记即可支持短程和远程任务。代码可在https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA获取。

articles.title: Can Speech LLMs Recognize When Audio Evidence Is Insufficient? A Diagnostic Study and a Pre-Generation Probing Mitigation
articles.abstract: Speech large language models are usually evaluated on questions that have answers. We ask what they do when a recording establishes none, and whether the standard way of finding out is sound. Diagnosed on synthesized speech the answer looks clear: Qwen2-Audio fabricates an answer to 92.5% of unanswerable questions, while an ASR cascade reading the same recordings reaches 2.5% hallucination at 6.7% over-refusal, placing the failure in reasoning rather than in perception. The identical protocol on 376 native SQuAD 2.0 questions over human-read recordings removes that conclusion: the cascade hallucinates on 67.7% against the end-to-end model's 69.8%, at a higher over-refusal cost. A paired subset asking the same questions of a synthesized and a human recording of each passage localises the effect in the ASR stage -- the end-to-end model's abstention behaviour does not move with the speaker, the cascade's goes from 11.1% to 65.9%. Reliance on synthesized speech has been named as a limitation of audio benchmarks but not quantified; we quantify it, and show it large enough to reverse a finding. Since no prompt we tested repairs the residual failure, we transfer pre-generation attention probing to the multimodal setting. A probe over frozen prompt representations reaches 0.773 AUROC at predicting which unanswerable questions the model will answer anyway, where semantic entropy over ten sampled generations is at chance: the model fabricates the same answer every time, so sample disagreement cannot see a failure it is confident about.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 6 tables. Accepted as a poster at SSPP 2026 (SMILES School Projects & Proceedings). Preprint also available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24347252. Code: https://github.com/ladnlav/slm-audio-evidence
articles.titleCn: 语音大语言模型能否识别音频证据不足？一项诊断研究和预生成探测缓解方法
articles.abstractCn: 语音大型语言模型通常在具有答案的问题上进行评估。我们探究了当录音无法提供答案时它们的表现，以及了解这一点的标准方法是否可靠。在合成语音上诊断的结果看起来很明确：Qwen2-Audio 对无法回答的问题中伪造答案的比例达到92.5%，而同一录音的ASR级联系统在6.7%的过度拒绝率下产生2.5%的幻觉，表明失败在于推理而非感知。在376个原生SQuAD 2.0问题中，使用人类朗读的录音进行相同协议测试，得出了相反的结论：级联系统在67.7%的情况下产生幻觉，而端到端模型的幻觉率为69.8%，且过度拒绝成本更高。一个配对的子集，对每个段落的人工合成语音和人类语音录音提出相同问题，将这种效应定位在ASR阶段——端到端模型的回避行为不随说话者变化，而级联系统的回避率从11.1%上升到65.9%。对合成语音的依赖被命名为音频基准的限制，但未量化；我们进行了量化，并表明其影响足以推翻一个发现。由于我们测试的任何提示都无法修复残余的失败，我们将预生成注意力探测转移到多模态设置。在冻结的提示表示上的探测在预测模型无论如何都会回答哪些无法回答的问题时达到了0.773 AUROC，而十个采样生成的语义熵处于机会水平：模型每次都伪造相同的答案，因此样本不一致无法揭示它对自己有信心的失败。

articles.title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
articles.abstract: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.
articles.comment: Codes are publicly available at: https://github.com/JunboShen/SAE-Audit
articles.titleCn: SAE审计：通过稀疏自编码器证据审计的黑盒LLM推理时优化进行临床试验预测
articles.abstractCn: 临床试验成本高昂且通常需要数年才能完成，因此早期结果预测对试验规划具有重要价值。大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于预测临床试验结果，但它们的预测仍然不可靠，其推理过程可能无法真实反映其答案背后的证据。在我们的实验中，对于预测已注册的临床试验是否会提前完成或终止等任务，前沿LLM的表现仅略好于随机猜测。我们引入了SAE-Audit，该技术通过从可部署的开源模型中获取证据，在推理时优化黑盒LLM。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的稀疏自动编码器（SAE）被转换为临床概念的词汇。基于过去临床试验拟合的稀疏探针确定哪些概念与结果相关。对于新方案，探针检测到的概念被写入证据，每个概念都包含其与结果关联的方向和强度，被审计的LLM根据这些证据优化其答案。无需额外训练，SAE-Audit将deepseek-v4-flash在五个临床试验预测任务上的平衡准确率提高了9.6至12.0个百分点，并将GPT-5.6-terra在试验完成预测上的准确率提高了8.0个百分点，大幅超越了其他自主推理时优化方法。作为辅助，SAE-Audit中的SAE探针模块本身具有准确性和可审计性，能够直接从验证的概念贡献和方案证据中提供自然语言解释，无需在推理时使用额外的LLM。SAE-Audit为更准确和可审计的临床试验预测提供了可验证的概念级证据，同时也可以嵌入到生物医学AI代理（如Biomni）中，以优化其性能。

articles.title: Automatic Construction of Persian E-Commerce Dialogue Datasets for Conversational Product Search
articles.abstract: Conversational product search lets users find products through a multi-turn dialogue instead of a single keyword query, but Persian lacks the large conversational datasets needed to train and evaluate such systems; existing Persian e-commerce dialogue resources cover few categories and small catalogs. We present a framework that builds such a dataset automatically from a real e-commerce catalog and release the resulting dataset. The framework crawls 12,926 products in seven categories of the Digikala marketplace, groups them into 170 semantically coherent clusters, and selects the question the assistant asks at every turn with the Regularized Partition Balance (RPB) score. The RPB score accounts for feature coverage, the probability that the user can answer and the number of values, and generalizes entropy-based question selection. An LLM then verbalizes each question plan into a natural Persian dialogue. In a simulation on the full catalog, the RPB score needs 0.11 fewer turns than the strongest entropy baseline when the difficulty of answering differs between features, and is practically equivalent to it when it does not. Using only a free LLM API, we generated 1,000 requirement-driven dialogues covering all 170 clusters, with turn-level feature annotations; automatic checks and an LLM judge confirm their consistency with the catalog, while their realism is lower than that of the first, GPT-4o-generated version. Code and data are publicly available.

articles.titleCn: 自动构建波斯电子商务对话数据集用于对话式产品搜索
articles.abstractCn: 对话式产品搜索允许用户通过多轮对话而非单一关键词查询来查找产品，但波斯语缺乏用于训练和评估此类系统的海量对话数据集；现有的波斯语电子商务对话资源覆盖类别少、目录小。我们提出一个框架，能够自动从真实电子商务目录中构建此类数据集，并发布由此产生的数据集。该框架爬取了Digikala电商平台七个类别的12,926个产品，将它们分组为170个语义上连贯的簇，并使用正则化划分平衡（RPB）分数选择助手在每一轮中提出的问题。RPB分数考虑了特征覆盖率、用户回答的概率以及值的数量，并推广了基于熵的问题选择。然后，使用大型语言模型（LLM）将每个问题计划转化为自然的波斯语对话。在全目录模拟中，当回答难度在特征之间不同时，RPB分数比最强的熵基线减少了0.11轮；当回答难度相同时，它与熵基线在实际中相当。仅使用免费的LLM API，我们生成了1,000个需求驱动型对话，覆盖所有170个簇，并带有回合级特征标注；自动检查和LLM裁判确认其与目录的一致性，但它们的真实性低于首个由GPT-4o生成的版本。代码和数据公开可用。

articles.title: Endpoint-Conditioned Process Value: What an Endpoint-Blind Process Score Adds Once Terminal Status and Cost Are Known
articles.abstract: Trajectory metrics promise information beyond final-answer accuracy, but no one has measured what a process score adds once an evaluation knows the outcome and the cost. We build that comparison: a sealed consequence needing an artifact neither agent nor judge ever sees, an operational baseline of terminal status and cost, and judge scale and evidence access as experimental factors. On 1,255 trajectories over 158 test-generation tasks in 7 Python repositories, the answer is gated on the judge. Four judges from 4B to 14B, one reasoning before scoring, add nothing an interval separates from zero; a Qwen3 32B judge on identical trajectories adds +0.050 AUC (95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]) and survives a refitting bootstrap ([+0.013, +0.095]). Most of what it adds is recoverable from eight behavioural counters, so a harness should log them (the judge adds +0.020 beyond them). What the judge is shown moves it further: disclosing the terminal verdict inflates its standalone discrimination by +0.103, while reference disclosure and tool-output redaction move it by nothing an interval separates from zero. A process metric reported without the judge's scale and evidence access does not identify a quantity. We release the protocol, the sealed-endpoint harness, and all trajectories.

articles.titleCn: 端点条件过程值：一旦终端状态和成本已知，端点盲过程评分会增添什么
articles.abstractCn: 轨迹指标承诺提供超越最终答案准确性的信息，但尚无人测量在评估知晓结果和成本后，过程分数能增加多少。我们构建了这种比较：一个需要代理和裁判都从未见过的封闭后果，一个终端状态和成本的运营基线，以及裁判的尺度与证据访问作为实验因素。在7个Python仓库的158个测试生成任务中，对1,255条轨迹的分析表明，答案受裁判控制。从4B到14B的4位裁判，在评分前进行推理，其增加的值与零的间隔无差异；在相同轨迹上使用Qwen3 32B裁判，增加了+0.050 AUC（95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]），并通过了重拟合引导检验（[+0.013, +0.095]）。其大部分增加可通过八个行为计数器恢复，因此应记录这些计数器（裁判在此基础上再增加+0.020）。裁判所见的内容使其进一步增加：披露终端裁决使其独立区分度增加+0.103，而披露参考和工具输出删除则无影响（与零的间隔无差异）。未包含裁判的尺度和证据访问的过程指标无法识别一个量。我们发布了协议、封闭端点 harness，以及所有轨迹。

articles.title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
articles.abstract: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). Additional features include centralized control of an agent group through a single EMIP agent client, collaborative object transportation by multiple agents, and experimental support functions such as recording and retrieving observation histories. By integrating these features into a reusable platform, EMIP aims to support research on human-human, human-agent, and agent-agent cooperation under different participant configurations and agent control methods. Usage examples illustrate concurrent speech and physical action, task coordination, and overlapping speech. The source code for the platform is publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform).
