articles.titleCn: EMIP：具身多方交互平台
articles.abstractCn: 能够支持多名参与者在共享环境中同时进行口语对话和执行物理动作的实验平台，对于研究人类与具身化AI代理之间的合作至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了EMIP（具身化多方交互平台），这是一个基于Minecraft构建的虚拟环境平台。通过基于互联网的客户端-服务器架构，EMIP将多名人类和多名AI代理连接到同一个虚拟环境中，并支持全双工语音通信和同步物理交互。它基于模型上下文协议（MCP）提供环境观察、物理动作执行以及音频输入输出的接口，使研究人员能够利用大型语言模型（LLMs）开发自己的代理控制方法。附加功能包括通过单个EMIP代理客户端对代理组进行集中控制、多名代理协同进行物体运输，以及实验支持功能（如记录和检索观察历史）。通过将这些功能集成到一个可复用平台中，EMIP旨在支持在不同参与者配置和代理控制方法下进行人类-人类、人类-代理和代理-代理合作的研究。使用示例展示了同步语音和物理动作、任务协调以及重叠语音的情况。该平台的源代码已在GitHub上公开发布（https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform）。

articles.title: Counting Symbols on Technical Drawings: A Benchmark and Verified Rewards for MLLMs
articles.abstract: Today's MLLMs can count objects in natural images. However, when asking them how many bolt holes appear in a mechanical drawing or how many nitrogen atoms are in a chemical structure, they often struggle. Counting in technical drawings remains challenging, as objects can be small, densely packed, or even implied by drawing conventions. To study this problem, we introduce CountDrawBench, a benchmark including floor plans, electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and molecular structures, with 1,574 counting questions and instance-level annotations where available. Besides evaluation, we introduce Code-Verified RL, a reinforcement learning framework that teaches MLLMs to count with executable feedback. Our method combines three complementary rewards: a count reward that checks the final answer, an instance-matching reward that verifies object locations, and a zoom-based reward that checks counting consistency across local image regions. All three are integrated into a unified GRPO objective. Extensive experiments reveal that even leading MLLMs struggle on CountDrawBench, with the best evaluated model achieving only 59.3% accuracy. Our method improves Qwen3.5-9B from 49.3% to 54.3% accuracy, outperforming all evaluated open-source baselines. These results establish CountDrawBench as a challenging testbed for technical drawing understanding and demonstrate the value of code-verified rewards in these tasks. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 8 figures
articles.titleCn: 在技术图纸中计数符号：一个基准和经验证的奖励，用于多模态大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 当前的多模态大语言模型能够对自然图像中的物体进行计数。然而，当询问它们机械图纸中螺栓孔的数量或化学结构中氮原子的数量时，它们往往难以应对。在技术图纸中进行计数仍然是一项挑战，因为物体可能非常小、密集堆积，甚至由绘图规范隐含。为了研究这一问题，我们引入了CountDrawBench，这是一个包含平面图、电气原理图、机械图纸和分子结构的基准，其中包括1,574个计数问题，并在可用的情况下提供实例级别的标注。除了评估之外，我们还引入了代码验证的强化学习（Code-Verified RL），这是一个通过可执行反馈来教导多模态大语言模型计数的强化学习框架。我们的方法结合了三种互补的奖励：一个检查最终答案的计数奖励、一个验证物体位置的实例匹配奖励，以及一个检查局部图像区域计数一致性的基于缩放的奖励。这三种奖励被整合到一个统一的GRPO目标中。大量实验表明，即使是领先的多模态大语言模型在CountDrawBench上也面临挑战，最佳评估模型的准确率仅为59.3%。我们的方法将Qwen3.5-9B的准确率从49.3%提升至54.3%，超越了所有评估的开源基线模型。这些结果确立了CountDrawBench作为技术图纸理解挑战性测试平台的价值，并证明了代码验证奖励在这些任务中的重要性。代码和数据将在被接受后公开。

articles.title: From Vanishing Gradients to Recursive Self-Improvement: Evaluating the Most Influential Papers in Large Language Model Evolution (1997-2026)
articles.abstract: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Model (LLM) research makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish incremental refinements from true paradigm shifts. This review evaluates 22 of the most influential publications spanning nearly three decades (1997-2026), organized through a causal, chronologically anchored taxonomy centered on the author's birth year (1999). Beginning "before 1999" with how recurrent neural networks (RNNs) forgot earlier context (much like forgetting Chapter 1 by the time a reader reaches Chapter 9), we trace how Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks introduced a "bouncer" mechanism of forget, input, and output gates to selectively preserve long-term memory. We then examine how Word2Vec turned language into vector mathematics (king - male + female ~ queen), why sequential RNNs hit a parallelization wall, and how the Transformer's all-to-all attention weights launched the modern LLM era alongside a quadratic bottleneck. Next, we analyze why scaling parameters alone leaves capacity under-trained unless data scales equally (Chinchilla), how Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) left alignment superficial, and how that gap compounded into adversarial jailbreaks and single-direction refusal subspaces (J-space), where instructing a model not to think of a restricted concept surfaces it much like the human "red ball" paradox. Finally, we synthesize the current state of AI (2024-2026), encompassing recursive model collapse, autonomous reasoning-model jailbreak agents, machine-speed agentic intrusions, and closed-loop recursive self-improvement (AIDE^2).
articles.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
articles.titleCn: 从梯度消失到递归自我改进：评估大型语言模型演进中最具影响力的论文（1997-2026）
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）研究的快速扩散使得人们越来越难以区分渐进式改进与真正的范式转变。本综述评估了22篇最具影响力的文献，时间跨度近三十年（1997-2026），并按照以作者出生年份（1999年）为基准的因果、时间锚定分类法进行组织。从"1999年前"开始，探讨循环神经网络（RNN）如何遗忘早期上下文（如同读者读到第九章时忘记第一章），接着追溯长短期记忆网络（LSTM）如何引入遗忘、输入和输出门机制来选择性地保留长期记忆。随后分析Word2Vec如何将语言转化为向量数学（king - male + female ~ queen），为何顺序RNN遭遇并行化瓶颈，以及Transformer的全连接注意力权重如何开启现代LLM时代并伴随二次方瓶颈。接着剖析为何仅靠扩展参数会导致容量未充分训练除非数据规模同步增长（Chinchilla），强化学习从人类反馈中（RLHF）为何导致对齐浅层化，以及这种差距如何加剧为对抗式越狱和单向拒绝子空间（J空间），其中禁止模型思考受限概念会使其浮现，类似于人类的"红球"悖论。最后，综合当前人工智能状态（2024-2026），涵盖递归模型崩溃、自主推理模型越狱代理、机器速度代理入侵，以及闭环递归自我改进（AIDE^2）。

articles.title: Beyond Omission: Measuring Critical-Information Fulfillment of Large Language Models in Bengali and English
articles.abstract: Evaluations of multilingual trustworthiness often ask whether a model leaves out information that a user needs. We examine whether that question is sufficient. Using 157 matched tasks written in English (EN), natural Bengali (BN) and Bengali-matrix Bengali-English code-switching (BN-CS), we scored 1,413 responses from three models (GPT-6.1 Sol, Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma 4 12B) against required information units (RIUs) fixed before any model was run. The scoring separates outright omission from content that is present but incorrect, insufficient or only partly met. The prespecified primary estimand, the domain-equal paired difference in critical omission rate (BN - EN), showed no detectable difference (+0.003, 95% CI -0.014 to +0.015), with omission near zero in every condition. The Bengali deficit appeared in fulfillment instead. Critical coverage was 0.050 lower in Bengali (95% CI 0.022 to 0.079) and strict complete-task success 0.093 lower (95% CI 0.055 to 0.131); both gaps came from the two open-weight models, and Sol showed none. Code-switching recovered part of the loss in RIU coverage (+0.028, 95% CI 0.012 to 0.045). On these data, an omission count alone would have shown no language gap. The automated judge passed prespecified agreement gates after a documented failed first attempt. A blind native-speaker rating of 60 study responses agreed with it on RIU scores (alpha 0.84) and critical RIUs (98% exact) but fell short on Bengali RIU agreement (alpha 0.77) and on the unsupported-content check (93% exact), and a blind check of its reason codes agreed on whether a critical unit was omitted for 79 of 81 units. Data, rubrics, responses, scores and code are released.

articles.titleCn: 超越遗漏：衡量孟加拉语和英语大型语言模型的关键信息满足度
articles.abstractCn: 多语言可信度评估通常询问模型是否遗漏了用户需要的信息。我们考察了这个问题是否足够。我们使用157个匹配任务（英语（EN）、自然孟加拉语（BN）和孟加拉语-英语代码转换孟加拉语（BN-CS）编写），对三个模型（GPT-6.1 Sol、Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma 4 12B）的1413个响应在模型运行前固定的必要信息单元（RIUs）进行评分。评分区分了完全遗漏和存在但错误、不足或仅部分满足的内容。预先指定的主要估计量，即领域相等的配对差异在关键遗漏率（BN - EN）上未显示出可检测的差异（+0.003，95% CI -0.014至+0.015），在每种条件下遗漏接近零。孟加拉语缺陷出现在满足要求上。孟加拉语的关键覆盖率低0.050（95% CI 0.022至0.079），严格完成任务成功率低0.093（95% CI 0.055至0.131）；这两个差距都来自两个开放式权重的模型，Sol没有显示。代码转换部分恢复了RIU覆盖率中的部分损失（+0.028，95% CI 0.012至0.045）。在这些数据上，仅遗漏计数不会显示出语言差距。自动裁判在记录了第一次失败尝试后通过了预定的协议门。60个研究响应的盲法母语者评分在RIU分数（alpha 0.84）和关键RIUs（98%精确）上与其一致，但在孟加拉语RIU协议（alpha 0.77）和支持内容检查（93%精确）上有所不足，对其原因代码的盲法检查在81个单元中的79个单元上同意了是否遗漏了关键单元。数据、评分标准、响应、分数和代码已公开。

articles.title: Which Failure Does an Intervention Repair? When Agent Interventions Help, and Where Self-Evolving Skills Stall
articles.abstract: An intervention that improves one agent can break another, and adding a stronger harness on top need not repair the damage. Agent interventions such as skills, harnesses, and extra inference budget are nonetheless usually credited with one average gain, measured under one setup. We ask instead when each intervention helps and which failure it repairs. A matched factorial study over nine benchmarks, four models, four skill conditions, four harness levels, and three budgets, with nearly 0.9 million trajectories, changes one axis at a time. No configuration is best everywhere, interventions interact rather than add, and a harness can absorb a skill's gain, rescue a failure the skill causes, or leave the gain intact. The failure left by the current system points to the fix: missing knowledge to a stronger model, execution errors to a richer harness. Yet feedback is not recovery: a matched recovery repairs mainly failures that leave a visible error signal. Skills that evolve from the agent's own experience hit a bottleneck: they rarely beat a short human-written skill, can learn dataset shortcuts, break when moved to another model, and cannot supply missing facts, which outside information does. A benchmark-level switch to the model favored by a 20-task labeled pilot achieves both higher performance and lower cost than always using the stronger model. Agent interventions should be judged by which failure they repair and under which configuration.

articles.titleCn: 干预修复了哪种失败？当代理干预时如何帮助，以及自我进化技能在哪里停滞。
articles.abstractCn: 一项改进一个代理的干预可能会破坏另一个代理，并且在顶部添加更强的挽具也不一定能修复损坏。尽管技能、挽具和额外推理预算等代理干预通常被认为在一种设置下平均有所增益，但我们询问的是每种干预何时有帮助以及它修复了哪种失败。一项涵盖九个基准、四种模型、四种技能条件、四种挽具级别和三种预算的匹配因子研究，涉及近90万条轨迹，每次只改变一个轴。没有哪种配置在所有地方都最佳，干预之间相互作用而非简单相加，挽具可以吸收技能的增益、挽救技能造成的失败，或保持增益不变。当前系统留下的失败点指明了改进方向：对更强大的模型缺失知识，对更丰富的挽具存在执行错误。然而反馈并非恢复：匹配恢复主要修复留下可见错误信号的失败。从代理自身经验中演化的技能遇到了瓶颈：它们很少能超越简短的人工编写技能，可以学习数据集捷径，在移至其他模型时容易失效，并且无法提供缺失的事实，而外部信息可以做到。切换到由20任务标记飞行员偏好的模型，在性能和成本方面均优于始终使用更强大的模型。代理干预应根据其修复的失败和配置进行评判。

articles.title: LLM-Based Assistant for Dog Care Guidance
articles.abstract: This study investigates whether domain grounding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can enhance the accuracy and reliability of pet care advice generated by large language models (LLMs). We curated a dataset of breed-specific dog care information and used it to develop two systems: a RAG pipeline based on TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, and a fine-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B model adapted using LoRA. Both systems were evaluated on 15 dog care questions. The RAG model achieved a perfect average score of 2.0, outperforming the fine-tuned model (mean = 1.47). Statistical analyses, including Welch's t-test, Mann-Whitney U, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (all p < 0.05), confirmed the significance of the performance gap. Our findings suggest that retrieval-based domain grounding leads to more accurate, consistent, and trustworthy responses than standalone fine-tuning in specialized LLM applications.
articles.titleCn: 基于大型语言模型的狗狗护理指导助手
articles.abstractCn: 本研究探讨了通过检索增强生成（RAG）进行领域接地和利用低秩适配（LoRA）进行参数高效微调是否能够提升大型语言模型（LLM）生成的宠物护理建议的准确性和可靠性。我们精心构建了一个包含品种特定犬类护理信息的数据库，并基于此开发了两个系统：一个基于TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0的RAG流程，以及一个使用LoRA适配的微调LLaMA-3.2-1B模型。这两个系统在15个犬类护理问题上进行了评估。RAG模型取得了完美的平均分2.0，优于微调模型（平均分1.47）。统计分析，包括Welch t检验、Mann-Whitney U检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验（所有p < 0.05），证实了性能差距的显著性。我们的研究结果表明，基于检索的领域接地比单独微调在专业LLM应用中能产生更准确、一致和值得信赖的响应。

articles.title: Dual-Side Uncertainty Estimation: Calibrating Data and Model Uncertainty into a Shared Probability Space
articles.abstract: Multimodal user intention analysis infers latent goals from heterogeneous behavioral observations but faces cross-modal input mismatch and output semantic errors. Existing uncertainty estimators focus on input reliability or output confidence and often reduce token uncertainty to simple statistics, overlooking structured dependencies. We propose DUE (Dual-Side Uncertainty Estimation), which jointly estimates input-side aleatoric and sentence-level epistemic uncertainty. From a single generation, Dirichlet perturbations of cross-layer representations produce an ordered token uncertainty sequence. A sequence-aware Normal-Inverse-Gamma estimator uses this sequence to quantify epistemic uncertainty and confidence in its estimate. Evidential multimodal alignment captures aleatoric uncertainty from noisy, incomplete, or inconsistent inputs. DUE calibrates both heterogeneous scores into a shared error-probability space and sequentially fuses them to estimate overall generation risk. Experiments demonstrate strong performance in input-mismatch detection, output semantic-error detection, and overall reliability estimation without repeated generation.

articles.titleCn: 双面不确定性估计：将数据和模型不确定性校准到一个共享的概率空间中
articles.abstractCn: 多模态用户意图分析通过异构行为观察推断潜在目标，但面临跨模态输入不匹配和输出语义错误的问题。现有的不确定性估计器主要关注输入可靠性或输出置信度，通常将标记不确定性简化为基本统计量，忽略了结构化依赖关系。我们提出了DUE（双边不确定性估计），它联合估计输入侧的偶然不确定性和句子级认知不确定性。通过单次生成，跨层表示的Dirichlet扰动产生有序的标记不确定性序列。序列感知的正态-逆伽马估计器利用该序列量化认知不确定性和其估计的置信度。证据多模态对齐从噪声、不完整或不一致的输入中捕获偶然不确定性。DUE将异构分数校准到共享的误差概率空间，并顺序融合它们以估计整体生成风险。实验表明，在输入不匹配检测、输出语义错误检测和整体可靠性估计方面表现出色，无需重复生成。

articles.title: On the Interplay between Backtracking and Latent Confidence Directions in Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: Reasoning models deliberate over multiple answer proposals, often resulting in excessively long traces due to backtracking, even when the correct answer has already been reached (Across three 32B models, ~87% of rollouts contain 1 unique answer yet still make ~8 answer proposals on average). Given this potentially "decorative" chain of thought (CoT) reasoning, can we look to the model internals to determine if the model will backtrack or commit to an answer proposal? Operating under the hypothesis that models maintain an internal representation of their uncertainty, we seek to extract this representation and characterize its relationship with backtracking behavior at answer proposals. By querying the model's verbalized confidence following answer proposals throughout a response trace, we extract a linear direction for latent confidence that separates high and low verbalized confidence. This direction can steer verbalized confidence as expected, but it surprisingly can also steer the next token probability of backtracking, performing on par with a linear direction extracted directly from backtracking examples. We then test the direction under progressively more realistic interventions. Steering continuously from a mid-trace answer proposal modulates response length (~-1.3k - ~+2.5k tokens) and the number of answer proposals (-4.18 - +4.75) in both directions, with minimal cost to accuracy. Applying the confidence direction from the start of generation, where proposal positions are unknown, still shortens traces at comparable accuracy, and its effect surfaces in the linguistic confidence of proposals. Overall, our study reveals the intricate interplay between a model's internal confidence and its proclivity to backtrack or commit to an answer.

articles.titleCn: 推理模型中回溯与潜在置信方向之间的相互作用
articles.abstractCn: 推理模型在多个答案提案之间进行权衡，由于回溯的存在，即使正确答案已经找到，也会导致过长的推理轨迹（在三个32B模型中，约87%的推理包含1个唯一答案，但平均仍提出约8个答案提案）。鉴于这种可能“装饰性”的思维链（CoT）推理，我们能否通过模型内部来判断模型是否会回溯或提交答案提案？基于模型维持其内部不确定性表示的假设，我们试图提取这种表示，并描述其与答案提案回溯行为的关系。通过查询模型在推理轨迹中答案提案后的口头置信度，我们提取了一个线性方向，该方向将高和低口头置信度分开。这个方向可以按预期引导口头置信度，但出乎意料的是，它也可以引导回溯的下一个标记概率，其表现与直接从回溯示例中提取的线性方向相当。然后我们在越来越现实的干预下测试这个方向。从推理中途的答案提案持续引导会调节响应长度（约-1.3k至+2.5k标记）和答案提案数量（-4.18至+4.75），且对准确率影响极小。从生成开始就应用置信度方向，即使提案位置未知，仍能在相当准确率下缩短轨迹，其效果体现在提案的语言置信度中。总的来说，我们的研究揭示了模型内部置信度与其回溯或提交答案倾向之间的复杂相互作用。

articles.title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
articles.abstract: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.

articles.titleCn: NoeVera：知识能否指导实验，实验能否完善知识？
articles.abstractCn: 随着对大型语言模型（LLM）服务的需求不断增长，优化LLM服务系统正变得越来越复杂，瓶颈已不再是预测给定配置的性能，而更难的问题是决定要研究什么：哪些机制对特定工作负载重要，哪些配置值得测试，以及决策仍需哪些证据。在这项工作中，我们提出了NoeVera，一个超越单次检索的智能第二大脑，它将论文、代码、基准测试和实验结果转化为一个具有三个层面的持久化知识库：源证据、可重用合成和智能体记忆。决策感知检索会组装紧凑的证据包，特定角色的智能体会对这些证据进行推理，并在需要定量支持时调用模拟器（Vidur或GAUSS），并且每个发现都会被写回为具有作用域的证据记录，以便知识指导实验，实验完善知识。在四个服务场景的配置搜索中，NoeVera在6-7次模拟器调用中就能达到最优解的95%，而贝叶斯优化需要9次调用，而使用相同工具的无知识智能体需要15次调用；在A100 GPU上，其代表性配置实现了约1.30倍的vLLM默认吞吐量，并满足所有场景的延迟目标。当重复使用时，具有来源保留证据记录在仅8%的应用场景陷阱中过度泛化，而通用智能体记忆在28%的场景中过度泛化。在一个72任务基准测试的48任务保留集上，NoeVera比同等配置的智能体高29%，比单次检索的对应版本高36%（0.80 vs. 0.62和0.59），即使基线接收了NoeVera自己的提示，其证据演化优势的统计显著部分仍然存在。

articles.title: Seeing Is Not Acting: WARD Diagnoses the Evidence-to-State-to-Action Gap in Longitudinal Clinical Agents
articles.abstract: Large language models for longitudinal clinical care must revise their assessments and actions as patient information accumulates. However, benchmarks centered on isolated responses or final task outcomes provide limited insight into intermediate failures in evidence use, state updating, and action selection. We introduce WARD, a benchmark for evaluating how clinical agents translate accumulating evidence into patient-state judgments and timely, safe actions. WARD comprises 4,560 clinical tasks across seven clinical output domains, organized into 240 checkpoints from 40 longitudinal clinical trajectories spanning 95 hospitalizations. Its Longitudinal Track evaluates these tasks under controlled cumulative evidence. Its Interactive Track evaluates end-to-end, tool-mediated clinical management across 271 verifiable evidence items and 141 reference transitions. Across 12 models with scorable checkpoint outputs, evidence recognition consistently outpaces downstream state and action decisions, with linked-evidence nonresponse reaching 74.47--90.90\%. Models also struggle to retain and update information over time, while in the Interactive Track only 11.46\% of executed actions advance a reference transition. These results reveal a persistent evidence-to-state-to-action gap and highlight the need for process-level evaluation of longitudinal clinical agents.Code and data: https://github.com/Dingsuper-creator/WARD.
articles.titleCn: 看见并非行动：WARD诊断纵向临床代理中的证据-状态-行动差距
articles.abstractCn: 用于纵向临床护理的大型语言模型必须随着患者信息的积累不断修正其评估和行动。然而，以孤立响应或最终任务结果为中心的基准对证据使用、状态更新和行动选择过程中的中间失败提供了有限的洞察。我们引入了WARD，这是一个用于评估临床代理如何将积累的证据转化为患者状态判断和及时、安全行动的基准。WARD包含4,560项临床任务，分布在七个临床输出领域，组织成240个检查点，涵盖40个纵向临床轨迹，每个轨迹跨越95次住院。其纵向轨迹在受控的累积证据下评估这些任务，其交互轨迹评估跨越271项可验证证据项和141项参考转换的全流程、工具介导的临床管理。在12个具有可评分检查点输出的模型中，证据识别始终领先于下游的状态和行动决策，而关联证据的非响应率高达74.47--90.90%。模型还难以随时间保留和更新信息，而在交互轨迹中，只有11.46%执行的行动推进了参考转换。这些结果揭示了证据到状态到行动的持续差距，并强调了评估纵向临床代理流程层面的必要性。代码和数据：https://github.com/Dingsuper-creator/WARD。

articles.title: Edit-Induced Dependency Mismatch: Propagation Omissions, Recovery, and Evaluation Blind Spots in Coding Agents
articles.abstract: During iterative code modification, coding agents may continue to rely in subsequent reasoning on outdated dependency judgments whose text remains fixed in the context, leading to errors in subsequent reasoning and leaving consumer defects undetected by the original task evaluations, thereby exposing blind spots in the tested benchmarks. We study actual agent execution trajectories collected on benchmark tasks: deepseek-v4-flash runs on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Verified, supplemented by Qwen3.8-Flash cases on FeatureBench. Focusing on edit-induced consumer obligations, a full-corpus blinded human audit of the DeepSWE runs identifies terminal mismatches, including diagnoses whose task scope remains disputed. Following supplementary execution checks, all retained DeepSWE terminal events have execution support. The audit also shows that recovery within a trajectory can coexist with terminal omissions in the same run. The process analysis links the presentation of relevant consumer code to explicit dependency judgments and subsequent synchronization actions recorded in the trajectories. An explicit dependency-review prompt reduces terminal omissions under the tested conditions, supporting re-derivation of consumer obligations after edits. Local replays of selected DeepSWE cases show that synchronizing the diagnosed consumers restores the target behavior while the listed controls continue to pass. Cross-benchmark execution counterexamples show that the original task evaluations do not fully detect edit-induced dependency mismatches: patches pass those evaluations, yet additional execution checks confirm unintended defects along existing consumer paths. These findings support measuring task scores, terminal propagation states, and recovery separately.
articles.titleCn: 编辑诱导的依赖性不匹配：编码代理中的传播遗漏、恢复和评估盲点
articles.abstractCn: 在迭代代码修改过程中，编码代理可能会在后续推理中继续依赖那些在上下文中保持不变的过时依赖判断，导致后续推理出现错误，并使原始任务评估未能检测到的消费者缺陷暴露出来，从而揭示了测试基准中的盲点。我们研究了在基准任务上收集的实际代理执行轨迹：deepseek-v4-flash 在 DeepSWE 和 SWE-bench Verified 上的运行，以及 Qwen3.8-Flash 在 FeatureBench 上的案例。聚焦于编辑引发的消费者义务，对 DeepSWE 运行进行全文本盲审，识别出终端不匹配，包括任务范围仍存在争议的诊断。补充执行检查后，所有保留的 DeepSWE 终端事件均有执行支持。审计还表明，轨迹内的恢复可以与同一运行中的终端遗漏共存。过程分析将相关消费者代码的呈现与轨迹中记录的明确依赖判断和后续同步操作联系起来。明确的依赖审查提示在测试条件下减少了终端遗漏，支持编辑后的消费者义务重新推导。对选定的 DeepSWE 案例进行本地重放显示，同步诊断的消费者恢复了目标行为，而列出的控制条件仍然通过。跨基准执行的反例表明，原始任务评估未能完全检测编辑引发的依赖不匹配：补丁通过了这些评估，但额外的执行检查确认了现有消费者路径上的未预期缺陷。这些发现支持分别测量任务分数、终端传播状态和恢复情况。

articles.title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
articles.abstract: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.
articles.titleCn: GameAnything：从任何灵感到可玩的游戏世界
articles.abstractCn: AI驱动的游戏开发有潜力将多样的人类灵感转化为互动体验。然而，现有的系统和基准主要关注显式开发规范，对适应多模态参考和评估实际游戏体验的支持有限。我们介绍了GameAnything，一个开源的智能平台，通过迭代开发将多模态灵感转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展。GameAnything集成了编码智能体、独立的试玩评论家、持续的开发状态和可重用的体验记忆，以支持持续优化。我们进一步提出了GameAnything-Bench，这是一个涵盖多样参考模态、游戏创作目标和游戏环境的基准，通过探索性试玩测试来评估功能正确性和游戏质量。对九种编码智能体配置的评估表明，当前的智能体能够适应参考内容，但在可玩交互和精确修改方面仍存在困难。此外，多模态参考提高了内容保真度，而迭代优化在不同智能体之间带来了实质但差异化的改进。这些发现突出了灵感驱动游戏开发的潜力和剩余挑战。

articles.title: IteraSong: LLM-Guided Iterative Symbolic Music Creation in a Web DAW
articles.abstract: Music creation is inherently iterative, yet many symbolic generation systems still center on producing or regenerating isolated outputs. We present IteraSong, an interactive web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) for LLM-guided iterative symbolic music creation. Unlike one-shot generation systems, IteraSong supports a generate-audition-edit-refine loop over a persistent multi-track project. Users initialize a fully labeled pop draft, then progressively refine it through natural-language instructions. The LLM maps requests to a hierarchical action space of editing primitives exposed via Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, spanning global, track, section, and bar/note scopes. The demo enables attendees to edit multi-track compositions in natural language, apply deterministic and generative edits, and undo/redo changes in real time.

articles.titleCn: IteraSong：基于LLM的迭代符号音乐创作网络数字音频工作站
articles.abstractCn: 音乐创作本质上具有迭代性，但许多符号生成系统仍然以产生或再生孤立输出为中心。我们提出了IteraSong，一个基于LLM指导的迭代符号音乐创作的交互式网络版数字音频工作站（DAW）。与一次性生成系统不同，IteraSong支持在持久的多轨项目上进行生成-试听-编辑-精炼的循环。用户首先初始化一个完全标注的流行乐初稿，然后通过自然语言指令逐步完善它。LLM将请求映射到通过模型上下文协议（MCP）工具暴露的编辑原语分层动作空间，涵盖全局、轨道、段落以及小节/音符范围。该演示使与会者能够以自然语言编辑多轨作品，应用确定性及生成性编辑，并实时撤销/重做更改。

articles.title: Direct Feedback Policy Optimization for AI Coding Agents
articles.abstract: AI coding agents generate, modify, and validate code through multi-turn interactions. Existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on sparse terminal rewards, making it difficult to assess how intermediate decisions affect task outcomes, and group-relative methods also require repeated sampling for each task. We propose Direct Feedback Policy Optimization (DFPO), a single-trajectory reinforcement learning algorithm that trains directly from a single trajectory. DFPO achieves higher task resolution rates than GSPO under matched base models and execution harnesses.
articles.titleCn: 直接反馈策略优化人工智能编程代理
articles.abstractCn: AI编码代理通过多轮交互生成、修改和验证代码。现有的强化学习方法通常依赖于稀疏的终端奖励，这使得难以评估中间决策如何影响任务结果，而相对方法也需要对每个任务进行重复采样。我们提出了直接反馈策略优化（DFPO），这是一种单轨迹强化学习算法，直接从单个轨迹进行训练。在匹配的基础模型和执行环境中，DFPO比GSPO实现了更高的任务解决率。

articles.title: ContextFact: Remembering Facts in Context for Long-Term Conversational Agents
articles.abstract: Agents built on large language models must maintain continuity across repeated interactions with users. However, long-term conversations scatter facts across turns and sessions, making it difficult to retrieve the right evidence with enough context. Memory for such conversations must therefore preserve facts with their context while keeping evidence selectively accessible. We first study how memory construction and retrieval-unit boundaries affect answerability and evidence access. Reading the entire memory bank reveals gaps that cannot be resolved by retrieval selection alone, showing that some context must be preserved during memory construction. Adjacent-turn grouping improves evidence access at matched unique-turn budgets, while wider windows do not consistently help. This motivates keeping fact-specific context local while organizing cross-session evidence separately. We propose ContextFact, which links context-preserving fact memories with source-grounded entity representations. Within sessions, it gathers the context needed to interpret each fact. Across sessions, it aligns recurring referents and revisits the source dialogue to reconstruct coherent entity representations linked to the supporting facts. At query time, ContextFact retrieves fact and entity views, reranks them independently, and uses entity-linked expansion to surface related facts; complete entity representations then provide organized cross-session evidence. With Qwen3.5-27B as the backbone, ContextFact achieves state-of-the-art performance while using only $21\%$ of the evidence tokens consumed by the strongest evaluated baseline, obtaining $86.49\%$ overall judge accuracy on LoCoMo and $91.00\%$ on LongMemEval-S. Controlled ablations support context-preserving fact boundaries and source-grounded entity reconstruction, while entity readout improves multi-hop accuracy beyond adding more facts.
articles.titleCn: 上下文记忆：长期对话代理中的情境事实记忆
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型的代理必须在多次与用户的交互中保持连续性。然而，长期对话中的事实分散在各个回合和会话中，导致难以在足够的上下文中检索正确的证据。因此，此类对话的记忆必须保存事实及其上下文，同时选择性地使证据可访问。我们首先研究了记忆构建和检索单元边界如何影响可回答性和证据访问。阅读整个记忆库揭示了仅靠检索选择无法解决的空白，表明在记忆构建过程中必须保留某些上下文。相邻回合分组在匹配的独特回合预算下提高了证据访问性，而更宽的窗口并不始终有帮助。这促使我们在保留特定事实上下文的同时，将跨会话证据分开组织。我们提出了ContextFact，它将保留上下文的事实记忆与来源锚定的实体表示链接。在会话内，它收集解释每个事实所需的上下文。在跨会话中，它对 recurring 指代进行对齐，并重访源对话以重建与支持事实关联的连贯实体表示。在查询时，ContextFact检索事实和实体视图，分别进行重新排序，并使用实体链接扩展来呈现相关事实；完整的实体表示随后提供有组织的跨会话证据。以Qwen3.5-27B为核心，ContextFact在仅使用21%的证据token（与最强评估基线相比）的情况下实现了最先进的性能，在LoCoMo上获得86.49%的整体裁判准确率，在LongMemEval-S上获得91.00%。受控消融实验支持保留上下文的事实边界和来源锚定的实体重建，而实体读取在添加更多事实之外进一步提高了多跳准确率。

articles.title: Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs
articles.abstract: Timely access to appropriate medical specialists remains a bottleneck in Bangladesh's healthcare system, as patients describe symptoms in informal Bangla rather than clinical terms, leading to ineffective referrals. This paper compares four model families for predicting medical specialties from Bangla patient narratives: six machine learning (ML) models using hybrid TF-IDF features, four deep learning (DL) models using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus, four fine-tuned transformers, and five large language models (LLMs) evaluated zero-shot. From a corpus of 3798 patient records covering 20 specialties, we retained the five with the most records (Medicine, Gynecology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology) and split the resulting 2730 records 80:20 into training and test sets shared by all families. The best transformer was XLM-RoBERTa (86.26% accuracy, 86.21% macro-F1), the best ML model was SVM (84.98%, 84.92%), the best DL model was Bidirectional GRU (80.77%, 80.83%), and the best LLM was Gemini (90.29%, 90.15%). Holm-corrected paired McNemar tests show SVM significantly outperforming Bi-LSTM (adjusted p = 0.004), whereas the Gemini-versus-Grok gap does not survive correction (adjusted p = 0.104), and neither the strongest transformer versus the weakest LLM (Grok) nor SVM versus the strongest transformer reaches significance. A tuned classical model is thus statistically indistinguishable from the strongest transformer, so accuracy rankings alone should not be read as evidence of one family's superiority. The findings provide a comparative baseline for Bangla medical text classification.

articles.titleCn: 基于孟加拉语患者叙述的医学专科预测：机器学习、深度学习、Transformer和大型语言模型的比较研究
articles.abstractCn: 在孟加拉国的医疗体系中，及时获得合适的专科医生仍然是一个瓶颈，因为患者用非正式的孟加拉语描述症状，而不是临床术语，导致转诊无效。本文比较了四种基于孟加拉语患者叙述预测医疗专科的模型：使用混合TF-IDF特征的六种机器学习（ML）模型、使用在语料库上训练的Word2Vec嵌入的四种深度学习（DL）模型、四种微调的Transformer，以及五种零样本评估的大型语言模型（LLMs）。从包含20个专科的3798份患者记录语料库中，我们保留了记录最多的五个专科（内科、妇科、皮肤科、儿科、消化内科），并将得到的2730份记录按80:20的比例分为训练集和测试集，所有模型共享该数据集。最佳的Transformer是XLM-RoBERTa（准确率86.26%，宏观F1分数86.21%），最佳的ML模型是SVM（84.98%，84.92%），最佳的DL模型是双向GRU（80.77%，80.83%），最佳的LLM是Gemini（90.29%，90.15%）。Holm校正配对McNemar检验显示SVM显著优于Bi-LSTM（调整p值=0.004），而Gemini与Grok的差距在校正后不再显著（调整p值=0.104），且最强的Transformer与最弱的LLM（Grok）之间、SVM与最强的Transformer之间的差异均未达到显著性。因此，经过调优的经典模型与最强的Transformer在统计上没有区别，仅凭准确率排名不应被视为某个模型家族优越的证据。这些发现为孟加拉语医疗文本分类提供了比较基准。

articles.title: VeriLogic: Reinforcement Learning over Verifiable Logical Reasoning Traces
articles.abstract: Logical reasoning derives conclusions from premises through explicit intermediate inference steps, providing a natural basis for process-level verification and supervision. However, existing learning methods often rely on response-level outcome signals, which overlook heterogeneous correctness within the reasoning trace: a correct answer may contain invalid reasoning, while valid intermediate steps may also appear in an incorrect response. To address this issue, we introduce Reinforcement Learning on Verifiable Logical Reasoning (VeriLogic), which turns internal reasoning traces into explicit and verifiable learning objects. Rather than treating a response as an indivisible learning unit, VeriLogic decomposes logical reasoning into explicit intermediate judgments, proofs, and final decisions, and organizes them into a unified "Grounding - Optimization - Refinement" pipeline: (1) Verification-Grounded Reasoning Environment Construction grounds logical reasoning into explicit intermediate states and formally checkable proof obligations, making the internal reasoning process accessible to verification and learning; (2) Logical Structured Policy Optimization learns from verifier feedback through complementary global and local rewards, jointly optimizing the overall reasoning outcome while providing targeted optimization signals to different intermediate reasoning paths; and (3) Verifier-Guided Iterative Refinement acts on verifier feedback by leveraging proof states and error messages to iteratively diagnose and repair failed reasoning. Experiments on six logical reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over strong baselines, with average improvements of 6.39% and 5.00% on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1. These results highlight the value of making logical reasoning traces verifiable, learnable, and refinable beyond final-answer supervision.
articles.titleCn: VeriLogic：基于可验证逻辑推理轨迹的强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 逻辑推理通过明确的中间推理步骤从前提中得出结论，为过程级的验证和监督提供了自然的基础。然而，现有的学习方法通常依赖于响应级的输出信号，忽略了推理过程中的异构正确性：一个正确的答案可能包含无效的推理，而有效的中间步骤也可能出现在错误的响应中。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了可验证逻辑推理的强化学习（VeriLogic），将内部推理轨迹转化为明确且可验证的学习对象。VeriLogic不是将响应视为不可分割的学习单元，而是将逻辑推理分解为明确的中间判断、证明和最终决策，并将它们组织成一个统一的“ grounding - optimization - refinement”流程：（1）验证基础推理环境构建将逻辑推理转化为明确的中间状态和形式可检查的证明义务，使内部推理过程对验证和学习变得可访问；（2）逻辑结构化策略优化通过互补的全局和局部奖励从验证器反馈中学习，联合优化整体推理结果，同时为不同的中间推理路径提供有针对性的优化信号；（3）验证器引导的迭代细化利用证明状态和错误消息对验证器反馈进行迭代诊断和修复失败的推理。在六个逻辑推理基准上的实验表明，与强基线相比具有持续的提升，在Qwen3和Llama-3.1上的平均改进分别为6.39%和5.00%。这些结果突出了在最终答案监督之外，使逻辑推理轨迹可验证、可学习和可改进的价值。

articles.title: Group-Balanced Supervised Fine-Tuning for Knowledge-Intensive Domains
articles.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) weights every supervised token equally, so on knowledge-dense corpora the loss budget follows token count rather than importance: on a legal QA benchmark, citation strings absorb 81% of the supervised loss weight budget while the answers being taught absorb 5%. We present Group-Balanced SFT (GB-SFT), which equalizes the loss budget across the semantic roles of tokens within a target sequence. With one tunable dial and one structural switch, GB-SFT contains standard SFT, class- and span-level balancing as corners whose geometry we characterize exactly. On benchmarks in law, medicine, code, and mathematics, we show across model families that: (i) GB- SFT injects new knowledge better than uniform SFT, pointwise token weighting, memory editing, and matched-budget data mixing; (ii) it matches the injection of masking out everything but the knowledge payload while retaining the citation recall that masking destroys (0.98 vs. 0.38); and (iii) role-aware grouping carries the gain: label-free partitions recover at most a third of it, an LLM tagger nearly all where the groups are lexically distinctive; and and (iv) the budget governs what fine-tuning breaks as well as what it learns, acting as a monotone lever on the safety-guardrail erosion SFT causes, at matched task accuracy. We release two new contamination-controlled knowledge-injection benchmarks with validated ground truth.
articles.titleCn: 面向知识密集型领域的组平衡监督微调
articles.abstractCn: 监督微调（SFT）平等地对待每个监督标记，因此在知识密集型语料库中，损失预算遵循标记数量而非重要性：在一个法律问答基准上，引用字符串吸收了81%的监督损失权重预算，而正在学习的答案只吸收了5%。我们提出了组平衡SFT（GB-SFT），它使目标序列内标记的语义角色之间的损失预算均衡。通过一个可调节的旋钮和一个结构开关，GB-SFT包含了标准SFT、类别和跨度级别的平衡作为其几何形状的精确特征。在法律、医学、代码和数学的基准测试中，我们跨模型系列展示了：(i) GB-SFT比均匀SFT、点状标记加权、记忆编辑和匹配预算数据混合更好地注入新知识；(ii) 它与仅保留知识有效载荷的遮蔽注入相匹配，同时保留了遮蔽会破坏的引用召回率（0.98 vs. 0.38）；(iii) 角色感知分组带来了收益：无标签的划分最多恢复三分之一，而LLM标记器在词汇上具有区分性的分组中几乎全部恢复；(iv) 预算不仅控制微调学习的内容，也控制其破坏的内容，作为SFT导致安全护栏侵蚀的单调杠杆，在匹配的任务精度下。我们发布了两个新的受污染控制的知识注入基准，并验证了其真实标签。

articles.title: When Can a Rewiring Control Test LLM Weight Readers? C2 and an Eligibility Protocol
articles.abstract: Large language models can predict the outputs of small neural networks from raw weights, but success could reflect recognition of weight-space regularities (fingerprints) rather than computation, and function-preserving controls cannot tell these apart. We propose C2, a counterfactual that permutes the columns of a network's final linear readout: every other parameter, and the readout's singular values, norms and entry multiset, are unchanged, and the function can change in an exactly recomputable way; we verify that each evaluated permutation does. C2 separates fingerprinting from computation only under three conditions, which we state as an eligibility protocol: a strategy restricted to C2-invariant summaries must already predict the target; C2 must change a property specific to the rewiring; and the reader's identity must be attested. No natural setting we tested is eligible. On tiny MLPs a frontier reader route followed the rewired function on all 24 networks, but invariant baselines were near chance and its backend could not be attested. In two public CNN zoos the conditions traded off: weight statistics predicted CIFAR-10 accuracy in-distribution, but C2's effect on accuracy was not specific to the swap, while per-image targets were specific but not predictable from invariant summaries. On a constructed population where a planted fingerprint rule works, all conditions hold and C2 separates a rule-following reader from an executor. A self-hosted Qwen3.8-27B followed the rewired function rather than the shortcut, and showed no evidence of using the weights with thinking disabled. A registered replication on fresh networks confirmed both findings (tracking minus stuck 0.875, 95% interval [0.750, 1.000]), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B also followed the rewiring (tracking minus stuck 0.729 [0.552, 0.885]). The transforms, audits and raw records are available from the authors.
articles.titleCn: 何时可以重新布线控制测试LLM权重读取器？C2和资格协议
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型可以从原始权重预测小型神经网络的输出，但成功可能反映了对权重空间规律（指纹）的识别，而非计算本身，而函数保持控制无法区分这些情况。我们提出了C2，一个对网络最终线性读出列进行置换的反事实：所有其他参数、读出的奇异值、范数和条目多重集保持不变，函数可以以完全可重计算的方式改变；我们验证了每个评估的置换都做到了。C2仅在三个条件下才能将指纹识别与计算区分开来，我们将这些条件表述为一个资格协议：策略仅限于C2不变的摘要必须已经预测了目标；C2必须改变特定于重连的属性；读取者的身份必须得到证实。在我们测试的没有自然设置符合资格。在微小的MLP上，一个前沿读取者路线在所有24个网络上都遵循了重连的函数，但不变基线接近随机，其后端无法证实。在两个公共CNN动物园中，条件进行了权衡：权重统计预测了分布内CIFAR-10的准确率，但C2对准确率的影响并非特定于交换，而单图像目标是特定的但无法从不变摘要中预测。在一个构造的种群中，一个植入的指纹规则有效，所有条件都成立，C2将一个遵循规则的读取者与执行者区分开来。一个自托管的Qwen3.8-27B遵循了重连的函数而非捷径，并且没有证据表明在禁用思考时使用权重。一个注册的复制在新鲜网络上证实了这两个发现（跟踪减去卡住0.875，95%区间[0.750, 1.000]），DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B也遵循了重连（跟踪减去卡住0.729 [0.552, 0.885]）。转换、审计和原始记录可以从作者处获得。

articles.title: Decoding Transformer Dynamics via Koopman Subspaces
articles.abstract: We apply Koopman operator theory and Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to characterise how large language models (LLMs) process different input topics. Treating the layer-to-layer evolution of hidden states as a dynamical system, we fit a linear Koopman operator and take the subspace spanned by its dominant modes as a per-topic spectral fingerprint. Four findings emerge. First, the depth map is near-linear: a single linear operator predicts each next-layer state to within approx. 18% relative error (interior variance explained approx. 0.99). Second, over the 57 MMLU subjects the fingerprint is topic-discriminative, matching the MMLU taxonomy at 0.72 nearest-neighbour purity and each subject's semantic neighbourhood at 0.75 any-hit@3. Third, it is a reproducible signature (split-half self-retrieval approx. 0.97$). Finally, these findings are consistent across seven base models (Qwen2.5 0.5-7B, Llama-3 1-8B), with a suggestive trend of alignment rising with MMLU accuracy. The spectral fingerprint thus provides a probe of how transformers process different topics across depth. Code is available at https://github.com/DeepK/koopman-llm-eacl27.

articles.titleCn: 通过Koopman子空间解码Transformer动力学
articles.abstractCn: 我们应用Koopman算子理论和动态模态分解（DMD）来表征大型语言模型（LLM）如何处理不同的输入主题。将隐藏状态逐层演化的过程视为一个动力系统，我们拟合了一个线性Koopman算子，并将其主导模态张成的子空间作为每个主题的频谱指纹。出现了四个发现。首先，深度图近似线性：单个线性算子可以预测下一层状态，相对误差在18%以内（内部方差解释率约为0.99）。其次，在57个MMLU主题中，该指纹具有主题区分性，与MMLU分类学的匹配度达到0.72的最近邻纯度，每个主题的语义邻域匹配度达到0.75的any-hit@3。第三，这是一个可重复的签名（分割一半自我检索率约为0.97）。最后，这些发现适用于七个基础模型（Qwen2.5 0.5-7B、Llama-3 1-8B），并显示出随着MMLU准确率提高，一致性趋势上升的迹象。因此，频谱指纹为理解Transformer如何随深度处理不同主题提供了探测手段。代码可在https://github.com/DeepK/koopman-llm-eacl27获取。

articles.title: Beyond Free-Form Generation: Measuring Interface Composition in Competitive NLP Systems
articles.abstract: Systems with decoder LLMs can combine free generation with scoring, ranking, or selection. We measure these documented interface combinations with five annotation fields linked to source evidence. The corpora comprise 517 solutions from 42 Kaggle competitions involving NLP and 76 participant systems from 26 SemEval, TREC, and WMT task years. Among eligible generation systems with decoder LLMs, 18 of 55 Kaggle systems and 17 of 20 Shared Task systems are hybrid: free generation coexists with a constrained interface. The remaining systems use free generation alone. Giving each competition or task year equal weight yields hybrid shares of 0.327 and 0.876. Within Eedi, 21 eligible systems with decoder LLMs have five exact interface profiles; ten LLM Science Exam systems share one interface class and have four profiles. Across Kaggle, the eligible systems with decoder LLMs span 18 exact interface profiles, revealing variation within broad task and backbone categories. These estimates characterize documented public systems selected using our selection criteria and include interfaces throughout the complete pipeline, including intermediate stages. The data are available at https://github.com/xiaoxinchenn/nlp-interface-composition.

articles.titleCn: 超越自由形态生成：衡量竞争性NLP系统中的界面组合
articles.abstractCn: 使用解码器LLM的系统可以将自由生成与评分、排序或选择相结合。我们通过五个与源证据相关的标注字段来衡量这些已记录的界面组合。语料库包括来自42个涉及自然语言处理的Kaggle竞赛的517个解决方案，以及来自26个SemEval、TREC和WMT任务年的76个参与者系统。在符合条件的解码器LLM生成系统中，55个Kaggle系统中有18个和20个Shared Task系统中有17个是混合的：自由生成与受限界面共存。其余系统仅使用自由生成。对每个竞赛或任务年给予同等权重，混合系统的比例分别为0.327和0.876。在Eedi中，21个符合条件的解码器LLM系统有五个精确的界面配置文件；10个LLM科学考试系统共享一个界面类别，并具有四个配置文件。在Kaggle中，符合条件的解码器LLM系统涵盖18个精确的界面配置文件，揭示了广义任务和骨干类别之间的变化。这些估计描述了我们选择标准下选定的已记录的公共系统，并包括整个完整管道中的界面，包括中间阶段。数据可在https://github.com/xiaoxinchenn/nlp-interface-composition获取。
